analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to quantify the global contribution of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and evaluate geographic and temporal variations. The focus is on HBV as the primary target, with HCV considered a related entity.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies were conducted, searching PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane databases from inception to February 19, 2026. Random-effects models were used to estimate pooled proportions, and temporal trends were assessed using nonlinear meta-regression with restricted cubic splines. Global estimates were generated by weighting country-specific estimates according to HCC incidence from GLOBOCAN 2022.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HBV infection was identified in 50.4% of HCC patients globally, with HCV infection in 25.8%. HBV was the predominant viral etiology in East Asia, Southeast Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa, whereas HCV contribution was highest in North Africa and the Middle East, Central Asia, and high-income North America. HBV&HCV co-infection accounted for 4.4% of HCC cases globally. The viral etiology of HCC is changing worldwide despite advances in hepatitis prevention and treatment.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes a recent resurgence in HBV-associated HCC, with a decline in earlier decades followed by an increase after approximately 2010. HCV-associated HCC demonstrated a nonlinear pattern, increasing in earlier decades and declining after a peak around 2005. The evidence highlights geographic and temporal variations but does not provide detailed mechanisms for these changes.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Continued identification and surveillance of individuals with chronic HBV or HCV infection remain essential for reducing the global burden of HCC. The findings suggest the need for targeted interventions in regions with high HBV and HCV contributions to HCC.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 878,083 HCC patients quantifies the global contribution of HBV and HCV infections to hepatocellular carcinoma. HBV was identified in 50.4% of patients, with HCV in 25.8%. HBV predominates in East Asia, Southeast Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa, while HCV is more prevalent in North Africa, the Middle East, Central Asia, and high-income North America. Temporal analyses reveal a decline in HBV-associated HCC before 2010 followed by an increase, and a nonlinear pattern for HCV-associated HCC with a peak around 2005. HBV&HCV co-infection accounts for 4.4% of HCC cases globally. The review concludes that the viral etiology of HCC is changing despite advances in hepatitis prevention and treatment. Continued surveillance and targeted interventions are recommended to reduce the global burden of HCC.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在量化 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 感染对肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的全球影响,并评估地理和时间变化。重点是将乙型肝炎病毒作为主要目标,丙型肝炎病毒被视为相关实体。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 对观察性研究进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析,检索了从成立到 2026 年 2 月 19 日的 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 数据库。使用随机效应模型来估计合并比例,并使用受限三次样条的非线性元回归来评估时间趋势。全球估计值是根据 GLOBOCAN 2022 的 HCC 发病率 对特定国家的估计值进行加权而生成的。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 全球 50.4% 的 HCC 患者发现 HBV 感染,25.8% 的 HCV 感染。乙型肝炎病毒是东亚、东南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲地区的主要病毒病原,而丙型肝炎病毒在北非、中东、中亚和高收入北美地区的贡献最高。HBV 和 HCV 混合感染占全球 HCC 病例的 4.4%。尽管肝炎预防和 治疗 取得了进展,但全球范围内 HCC 的病毒病因正在发生变化。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review aims to quantify the global contribution of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and evaluate geographic and temporal variations. analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies were conducted, searching PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane databases from inception to February 19, 2026. Global estimates were generated by weighting country-specific estimates according to HCC incidence from GLOBOCAN 2022.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HBV infection was identified in 50.4% of HCC patients globally, with HCV infection in 25.8%. title_zh: 肝细胞癌中 HBV 和 HCV 归因的全球重新评估:对 878,083 名患者的系统回顾和荟萃分析揭示了最近的复发
source_body_en: Abstract Background and Aims The contribution of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has changed with advances in vaccination and antiviral therapy. We aimed to quantify their global contribution and evaluate geographic and temporal variations. Methods We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies reporting HBV or HCV infection among HCC patients. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane databases were searched from inception to February 19, 2026. Random-effects models were used to estimate pooled proportions. Global estimates were generated by weighting country-specific estimates according to HCC incidence from GLOBOCAN 2022. Temporal trends were assessed using nonlinear meta-regression with restricted cubic splines. Results A total of 344 studies including 878,083 HCC patients were included. HBV infection was identified in 50.4% of patients and HCV infection in 25.8%. HBV was the predominant viral etiology in East Asia, Southeast Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa, whereas HCV contribution was highest in North Africa and the Middle East, Central Asia, and high-income North America. Temporal analyses showed a decline in HBV-associated HCC during earlier decades followed by an increase after approximately 2010. HCV-associated HCC demonstrated a nonlinear pattern, increasing in earlier decades and declining after a peak around 2005. HBV&HCV co-infection accounted for 4.4% of HCC cases globally. Conclusions The viral etiology of HCC is changing worldwide despite advances in hepatitis prevention and treatment. Continued identification and surveillance of individuals with chronic HBV or HCV infection remain essential for reducing the global burden of HCC.

title: The Clinical Utility of Adding Laminin Gamma 2 Monomer to the PAGE‐B Score for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Surveillance in Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims A residual risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) persists despite the use of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NA) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. We aimed to assess the utility of baseline serum laminin gamma 2 monomer (LG2m) by integrating PAGE‐B score to predict HCC. Methods NA‐treated CHB patients whose baseline serum LG2m, alpha‐fetoprotein (AFP) and PAGE‐B score were measured. We evaluated the predictive value of LG2m in subgroups stratified by cirrhosis status and PAGE‐B score and proposed a HCC surveillance algorithm. Results HCC developed in 56 of 1016 patients over a follow‐up of 3651 person‐years (annual incidence: 1.53%). None of the low PAGE‐B patients developed HCC over 5 years. LG2m did not significantly stratify risk in high PAGE‐B patients. Conversely, LG2m was significantly predictive of HCC in nonhigh PAGE‐B patients (5‐year incidence: 5.5% vs. low LG2m, p = 0.004). Integrating LG2m, AFP, and high PAGE‐B achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% for HCC detection. Among patients with a nonhigh PAGE‐B score, elevated LG2m was associated with a higher risk of HCC (adjusted HR, 4.40; 95% CI, 1.26–15.44), whereas AFP did not significantly stratify HCC risk in a separate analysis. Intermediate PAGE‐B patients with high LG2m should receive closer HCC surveillance (annual incidence: 1.4%) as with high PAGE‐B patients did (annual incidence: 1.9%). Conclusion Serum LG2m level was predictive of HCC specifically among patients with intermediate PAGE‐B score. Integration of LG2m into a PAGE‐B‐oriented algorithm provides a biomarker‐driven tool for individualized surveillance, which is vital for improving early‐stage HCC detection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估在 PAGE-B 评分中添加层粘连蛋白 γ 2 单体 (LG2m) 用于预测 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的临床效用。尽管在 CHB 患者中使用核苷(酸)类似物 (NA),但 HCC 的残余风险仍然存在。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及接受 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者,测量了其基线血清 LG2m、甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 和 PAGE-B 评分。在 3651 人年的随访中,1016 名患者中有 56 名发生 HCC(年度 发病率:1.53%)。低 PAGE-B 患者中没有一名患者在 5 年内发展为 HCC。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括测量 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者的基线血清 LG2m、AFP 和 PAGE-B 评分。LG2m 的预测价值在按肝硬化状态和 PAGE-B 评分分层的亚组中进行评估。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the clinical utility of adding laminin gamma 2 monomer (LG2m) to the PAGE‐B score for predicting hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved NA-treated CHB patients whose baseline serum LG2m, alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), and PAGE-B score were measured. analysis_en.methods: The methods included measuring baseline serum LG2m, AFP, and PAGE-B score in NA-treated CHB patients. The predictive value of LG2m was evaluated in subgroups stratified by cirrhosis status and PAGE-B score.
analysis_en.main_results: Among patients with a nonhigh PAGE-B score, elevated LG2m was associated with a higher risk of HCC (adjusted HR, 4.40; 95% CI, 1.26–15.44), whereas AFP did not significantly stratify HCC risk in a separate analysis.

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中将层粘连蛋白 Gamma 2 单体添加到 PAGE-B 评分中对肝细胞癌 监测 的临床效用
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background and Aims A residual risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) persists despite the use of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NA) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. We aimed to assess the utility of baseline serum laminin gamma 2 monomer (LG2m) by integrating PAGE‐B score to predict HCC. Methods NA‐treated CHB patients whose baseline serum LG2m, alpha‐fetoprotein (AFP) and PAGE‐B score were measured. We evaluated the predictive value of LG2m in subgroups stratified by cirrhosis status and PAGE‐B score and proposed a HCC surveillance algorithm. Results HCC developed in 56 of 1016 patients over a follow‐up of 3651 person‐years (annual incidence: 1.53%). None of the low PAGE‐B patients developed HCC over 5 years. LG2m did not significantly stratify risk in high PAGE‐B patients. Conversely, LG2m was significantly predictive of HCC in nonhigh PAGE‐B patients (5‐year incidence: 5.5% vs. low LG2m, p = 0.004). Integrating LG2m, AFP, and high PAGE‐B achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% for HCC detection. Among patients with a nonhigh PAGE‐B score, elevated LG2m was associated with a higher risk of HCC (adjusted HR, 4.40; 95% CI, 1.26–15.44), whereas AFP did not significantly stratify HCC risk in a separate analysis. Intermediate PAGE‐B patients with high LG2m should receive closer HCC surveillance (annual incidence: 1.4%) as with high PAGE‐B patients did (annual incidence: 1.9%). Conclusion Serum LG2m level was predictive of HCC specifically among patients with intermediate PAGE‐B score. Integration of LG2m into a PAGE‐B‐oriented algorithm provides a biomarker‐driven tool for individualized surveillance, which is vital for improving early‐stage HCC detection.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 尽管在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中使用核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗,肝细胞癌(HCC)的残留风险仍存在。我们旨在通过整合PAGE‐B评分,评估基线血清层粘连蛋白γ2单体(LG2m)在预测HCC中的作用。方法 收集了接受NA治疗的CHB患者的基线血清LG2m、甲胎蛋白(AFP)和PAGE‐B评分数据。我们评估了LG2m在按肝硬化状态和PAGE‐B评分分层的亚组中的预测价值,并提出了一个HCC 监测算法。结果 在随访3651人年期间,1016名患者中有56人发展为HCC(年发病率:1.53%)。在低PAGE‐B评分患者中,5年内未见HCC发生。在高PAGE‐B评分患者中,LG2m未能显著分层HCC风险。相反,在非高PAGE‐B评分患者中,LG2m显著预测HCC发生(5年发病率:5.5% vs. 低LG2m,p = 0.004)。将LG2m、AFP和高PAGE‐B评分整合后,HCC检测的敏感度达到98.2%。在非高PAGE‐B评分患者中,升高的LG2m与更高的HCC风险相关(调整后风险比,4.40;95%置信区间,1.26–15.44),而AFP在单独分析中未能显著分层HCC风险。对于具有中等PAGE‐B评分且高LG2m的患者,应像高PAGE‐B评分患者一样进行更密切的HCC 监测监测(年发病率:1.4%),而高PAGE‐B评分患者的年发病率为1.9%。结论 血清LG2m水平在具有中等PAGE‐B评分的患者中可特异性预测HCC。将LG2m整合到以PAGE‐B为导向的算法中,可提供一种基于生物标志物的个体化监测工具,这对于提高早期HCC检测至关重要。

title: Adherence to European AIDS clinical society hepatitis B management guidelines in people with HIV: real-world evidence from Spain and Germany.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate adherence to hepatitis B virus (HBV) management recommendations among people with HIV (PWH) and chronic HBV infection. DESIGN: A multicenter cross-sectional study. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study in 42 centers in Spain and Germany between June 2024 and March 2025. Chronic HBV infection was defined as at least two positive hepatitis B surface antigen tests obtained more than 6 months apart. Adherence to 2023 European AIDS Clinical Society recommendations regarding anti-HBV treatment, liver enzyme monitoring, HBV-DNA testing, antihepatitis D virus (HDV) screening, and HDV-RNA confirmation was assessed. Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance was evaluated separately and has been reported elsewhere. RESULTS: A total of 1235 PWH with chronic HBV infection were included. The median age was 56 years, 84% were men, and 36% were born outside Europe. Overall, 88% had HIV-RNA less than 50 copies/ml, and the median CD4+ cell count was 623 cells/μl. Among participants with available HBV-DNA result, 87% had undetectable HBV-DNA. Guideline-recommended anti-HBV treatment was documented in 88% of individuals. During the previous 12 months, liver enzyme monitoring was performed in 94% and HBV-DNA testing in 71%. Overall, 81% had ever undergone anti-HDV testing and, among anti-HDV-positive individuals, 66% had undergone HDV-RNA testing. CONCLUSION: Although adherence to several components of HBV care was high, gaps remain in the implementation of current recommendations for PWH, particularly in HBV-DNA monitoring and HDV evaluation. Better integration of these measures into routine HIV care may improve long-term prevention of liver-related complications.

A multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted in 42 centers between June 2024 and March 2025, including 1235 participants. Chronic HBV infection was defined based on two positive hepatitis B surface antigen tests more than 6 months apart. Adherence to 2023 European AIDS Clinical Society recommendations was assessed, including anti-HBV treatment, liver enzyme monitoring, HBV-DNA testing, anti-HDV screening, and HDV-RNA confirmation. analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate adherence to hepatitis B virus (HBV) management recommendations among people with HIV (PWH) and chronic HBV infection, addressing the need to understand how well current guidelines are implemented in clinical practice.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted in 42 centers in Spain and Germany between June 2024 and March 2025, including a total of 1235 PWH with chronic HBV infection.
analysis_en.methods: Chronic HBV infection was defined as at least two positive hepatitis B surface antigen tests obtained more than 6 months apart. Adherence to 2023 European AIDS Clinical Society recommendations regarding anti-HBV treatment, liver enzyme monitoring, HBV-DNA testing, antihepatitis D virus (HDV) screening, and HDV-RNA confirmation was assessed.
analysis_en.main_results: Among participants with available HBV-DNA result, 87% had undetectable HBV-DNA. Overall, 81% had ever undergone anti-HDV testing and, among anti-HDV-positive individuals, 66% had undergone HDV-RNA testing.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that although adherence to several components of HBV care was high, gaps remain in the implementation of current recommendations for PWH, particularly in HBV-DNA monitoring and HDV evaluation.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that better integration of these measures into routine HIV care may improve long-term prevention of liver-related complications.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which does not allow for causal inference, and the data may not be fully generalizable to other populations.

title_zh: HIV 感染者遵守欧洲艾滋病临床学会乙型肝炎管理指南:来自西班牙和德国的真实世界证据。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate adherence to hepatitis B virus (HBV) management recommendations among people with HIV (PWH) and chronic HBV infection. DESIGN: A multicenter cross-sectional study. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study in 42 centers in Spain and Germany between June 2024 and March 2025. Chronic HBV infection was defined as at least two positive hepatitis B surface antigen tests obtained more than 6 months apart. Adherence to 2023 European AIDS Clinical Society recommendations regarding anti-HBV treatment, liver enzyme monitoring, HBV-DNA testing, antihepatitis D virus (HDV) screening, and HDV-RNA confirmation was assessed. Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance was evaluated separately and has been reported elsewhere. RESULTS: A total of 1235 PWH with chronic HBV infection were included. The median age was 56 years, 84% were men, and 36% were born outside Europe. Overall, 88% had HIV-RNA less than 50 copies/ml, and the median CD4+ cell count was 623 cells/μl. Among participants with available HBV-DNA result, 87% had undetectable HBV-DNA. Guideline-recommended anti-HBV treatment was documented in 88% of individuals. During the previous 12 months, liver enzyme monitoring was performed in 94% and HBV-DNA testing in 71%. Overall, 81% had ever undergone anti-HDV testing and, among anti-HDV-positive individuals, 66% had undergone HDV-RNA testing. CONCLUSION: Although adherence to several components of HBV care was high, gaps remain in the implementation of current recommendations for PWH, particularly in HBV-DNA monitoring and HDV evaluation. Better integration of these measures into routine HIV care may improve long-term prevention of liver-related complications.
abstract_zh: 目的:评估 HIV 感染者 (PWH) 和慢性 HBV 感染者对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 管理建议的遵守情况。设计:一项多中心横断面研究。方法:我们于 2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 3 月期间在西班牙和德国的 42 个中心进行了一项横断面研究。慢性 HBV 感染的定义是至少两次相隔 6 个月以上的乙型肝炎表面抗原检测呈阳性。对 2023 年欧洲艾滋病临床协会关于抗 HBV 治疗、肝酶监测、HBV-DNA 检测、抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 筛查和 HDV-RNA 确认的建议的遵守情况进行了评估。肝细胞癌 监测 单独进行了评估,并已在其他地方报道过。结果:共纳入 1235 名慢性 HBV 感染者。中位年龄为 56 岁,84% 为男性,36% 出生于欧洲以外地区。总体而言,88% 的 HIV-RNA 低于 50 拷贝/ml,CD4+ 细胞计数中位数为 623 个细胞/μl。在可获得 HBV-DNA 结果的参与者中,87% 的 HBV-DNA 检测不到。88% 的个体记录了指南推荐的抗 HBV 治疗。在过去 12 个月中,94% 的人进行了肝酶监测,71% 的人进行了 HBV-DNA 检测。总体而言,81% 的人曾经接受过抗 HDV 检测,而在抗 HDV 阳性个体中,66% 的人接受过 HDV-RNA 检测。结论:尽管对 HBV 护理的多个组成部分的依从性很高,但在实施当前的感染者卫生保健建议方面仍存在差距,特别是在 HBV-DNA 监测和 HDV 评估方面。将这些措施更好地融入日常艾滋病毒护理中可能会改善肝脏相关并发症的长期预防。

title: Reactive markers of HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia, Bulgaria: a cross-sectional bio-behavioural survey
abstract: Abstract Background In eastern Europe and central Asia, HIV incidence among people who inject drugs has continued to rise, yet contemporary bio-behavioural data from Bulgaria are scarce. We measured the prevalence of reactive screening markers for HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia and examined their correlates. Methods Cross-sectional survey of 480 adults reporting illicit drug use in the previous month, recruited through mobile outreach in June–August 2024. Capillary blood was screened on site with rapid tests. Because the outcomes are common, associations are expressed as adjusted prevalence ratios from modified Poisson regression with robust variance, with covariates chosen from a directed acyclic graph rather than by significance screening. Results Of 480 participants (78.8% men, median age 40 years), 320 (66.7%, 95% confidence interval 62.3–70.9) had at least one reactive marker. Anti-HCV was reactive in 305 (63.5%, 59.1–67.9), anti-HIV in 61 (12.7%, 9.9–16.0), treponemal antibody in 15 (3.1%, 1.8–5.1) and HBsAg in 11 (2.3%, 1.1–4.1). Reactivity was concentrated among the 304 participants who had ever injected (anti-HCV 89.1% vs 19.3% among those who had not; anti-HIV 17.1% vs 5.1%), whereas treponemal antibody and HBsAg did not differ by injecting history. Anti-HCV reactivity rose from 25.0% at 20–29 years to 82.0% at 40–49 years (test for trend p

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the scarcity of contemporary bio-behavioural data on HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia, Bulgaria, given the rising incidence of HIV in eastern Europe and central Asia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional survey of 480 adults who reported illicit drug use in the previous month was conducted in Sofia, Bulgaria, from June to August 2024.
analysis.methods: Capillary blood was screened on site using rapid tests, and associations were expressed as adjusted prevalence ratios from modified Poisson regression with robust variance, using covariates chosen from a directed acyclic graph.
analysis.main_results: Of 480 participants (78.8% men, median age 40 years), 320 (66.7%, 95% confidence interval 62.3–70.9) had at least one reactive marker. Anti-HCV was reactive in 305 (63.5%, 59.1–67.9), anti-HIV in 61 (12.7%, 9.9–16.0), treponemal antibody in 15 (3.1%, 1.8–5.1) and HBsAg in 11 (2.3%, 1.1–4.1).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that anti-HCV reactivity was concentrated among those who had ever injected drugs, while treponemal antibody and HBsAg did not differ by injecting history. The findings suggest a need for targeted interventions among injectors to reduce the burden of HCV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance and prevention strategies for HCV among people who use drugs, particularly in Sofia, Bulgaria, where the prevalence is high.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the reliance on self-reported drug use, which may introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study surveyed 480 people who use drugs in Sofia, Bulgaria, and found high prevalence of hepatitis C virus (63.5%) and HIV (12.7%), with reactivity concentrated among injectors. The findings highlight the need for targeted interventions to reduce HCV burden.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the scarcity of contemporary bio-behavioural data on HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia, Bulgaria, given the rising incidence of HIV in eastern Europe and central Asia.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional survey of 480 adults who reported illicit drug use in the previous month was conducted in Sofia, Bulgaria, from June to August 2024.
elements_en.methods: Capillary blood was screened on site using rapid tests, and associations were expressed as adjusted prevalence ratios from modified Poisson regression with robust variance, using covariates chosen from a directed acyclic graph.
elements_en.main_results: Of 480 participants (78.8% men, median age 40 years), 320 (66.7%, 95% confidence interval 62.3–70.9) had at least one reactive marker. Anti-HCV was reactive in 305 (63.5%, 59.1–67.9), anti-HIV in 61 (12.7%, 9.9–16.0), treponemal antibody in 15 (3.1%, 1.8–5.1) and HBsAg in 11 (2.3%, 1.1–4.1).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that anti-HCV reactivity was concentrated among those who had ever injected drugs, while treponemal antibody and HBsAg did not differ by injecting history. The findings suggest a need for targeted interventions among injectors to reduce the burden of HCV.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance and prevention strategies for HCV among people who use drugs, particularly in Sofia, Bulgaria, where the prevalence is high.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the reliance on self-reported drug use, which may introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 在东欧和中亚,注射吸毒者中的 HIV 发病率 持续上升,但保加利亚的当代生物行为数据却很少。我们测量了索非亚吸毒者中艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎、丙型肝炎和梅毒的反应性筛查标记物 患病率,并检查了它们的相关性。方法 对 2024 年 6 月至 8 月通过流动外展招募的 480 名上月报告非法药物使用的成年人进行横断面调查。通过快速检测对毛细血管血进行现场筛查。由于结果很常见,因此关联性表示为来自具有鲁棒方差的修正泊松回归的调整后的 患病率 比率,协变量是从有向非循环图中选择的,而不是通过显着性筛选。结果 480 名参与者(78.8% 为男性,中位年龄 40 岁)中,320 名参与者(66.7%,95% 置信区间 62.3–70.9)至少有一种反应性标志物。305 例 (63.5%,59.1–67.9) 出现抗 HCV 反应,61 例 (12.7%,9.9–16.0) 出现抗 HIV 反应,15 例 (3.1%,1.8–5.1) 出现密螺旋体抗体反应,11 例 (2.3%,1.1–4.1) 出现 HBsAg 反应。反应性集中在曾经注射过的 304 名参与者中(抗 HCV 为 89.1%,未注射过的参与者为 19.3%;抗 HIV 为 17.1%,未注射过 5.1%),而密螺旋体抗体和 HBsAg 并没有因注射史而存在差异。抗 HCV 反应性从 20-29 岁时的 25.0% 上升至 40-49 岁时的 82.0%(趋势 p 检验)

title: Interferon-λ receptor positive monocytes/macrophages orchestrate a pro-fibrotic immune environment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis.
abstract: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL-10Rβ, mediates IFN-λ-driven fibrotic effects. This study investigated the involvement of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment. Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood showed that IFNLR1+ monocytes were elevated in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (CHI) and patients with HBV-related liver cirrhosis (LC), compared with healthy controls (HC). These cells also displayed a CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi phenotype with an IL-10hiTNF-αhi cytokine profile. Hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno-associated virus 8-1.3HBV. Ifnlr1 deficiency down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. In vitro, bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) were co-cultured with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells to assess the functional impact of IFNLR1+ macrophages. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN-λ/IFNLR1-mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the role of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating a pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood from patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and liver cirrhosis, compared with healthy controls. Additionally, hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno-associated virus 8-1.3HBV.
analysis.methods: The study used flow cytometry to analyze monocyte/macrophage populations and their phenotypes. In vitro experiments involved co-culturing bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells. The involvement of lipid metabolism was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists and antagonists.
analysis.main_results: Flow cytometric analysis showed elevated IFNLR1+ monocytes in patients with chronic HBV infection and liver cirrhosis compared to healthy controls. Ifnlr1 deficiency in mice down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, reduced collagen deposition, but increased HBV-DNA replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages play a critical role in promoting liver fibrosis through their immunoregulatory functions, and that targeting the IFNLR1-LXR axis may offer new therapeutic strategies for HBV-related fibrosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of anti-fibrotic therapies targeting IFNLR1 and LXR pathways for patients with HBV-related liver fibrosis, potentially improving disease management and outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and animal models, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of direct human clinical outcomes and the potential for species-specific differences.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the role of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in promoting a pro-fibrotic immune environment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis. Using flow cytometry and in vitro experiments, the research demonstrates that these cells are elevated in patients with chronic HBV infection and cirrhosis, and that their absence in mice reduces collagen deposition but increases HBV-DNA replication. The findings suggest that IFNLR1+ macrophages contribute to fibrosis through immunoregulatory mechanisms, and that targeting the IFNLR1-LXR axis may offer therapeutic potential. However, the study is limited to animal models and in vitro settings, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of direct human clinical data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 IFNLR1+ 单核细胞/巨噬细胞在 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝纤维化中协调促纤维化免疫微环境中的作用。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the role of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating a pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood from patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and liver cirrhosis, compared with healthy controls. Additionally, hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno-associated virus 8-1.3HBV.
analysis_en.methods: The study used flow cytometry to analyze monocyte/macrophage populations and their phenotypes. In vitro experiments involved co-culturing bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells. The involvement of lipid metabolism was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists and antagonists.
analysis_en.main_results: Flow cytometric analysis showed elevated IFNLR1+ monocytes in patients with chronic HBV infection and liver cirrhosis compared to healthy controls. Ifnlr1 deficiency in mice down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, reduced collagen deposition, but increased HBV-DNA replication.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages play a critical role in promoting liver fibrosis through their immunoregulatory functions, and that targeting the IFNLR1-LXR axis may offer new therapeutic strategies for HBV-related fibrosis.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of anti-fibrotic therapies targeting IFNLR1 and LXR pathways for patients with HBV-related liver fibrosis, potentially improving disease management and outcomes.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and animal models, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of direct human clinical outcomes and the potential for species-specific differences.

title_zh: 干扰素 λ 受体阳性单核细胞/巨噬细胞在 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝纤维化中协调促纤维化免疫环境。
source_body_en: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL-10Rβ, mediates IFN-λ-driven fibrotic effects. This study investigated the involvement of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment. Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood showed that IFNLR1+ monocytes were elevated in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (CHI) and patients with HBV-related liver cirrhosis (LC), compared with healthy controls (HC). These cells also displayed a CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi phenotype with an IL-10hiTNF-αhi cytokine profile. Hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno-associated virus 8-1.3HBV. Ifnlr1 deficiency down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. In vitro, bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) were co-cultured with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells to assess the functional impact of IFNLR1+ macrophages. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN-λ/IFNLR1-mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 干扰素-λ 受体 (IFNLR) 是一种由 IFNLR1 和 IL-10Rβ 组成的异二聚体,介导 IFN-λ 驱动的纤维化作用。本研究调查了 IFNLR1+ 单核细胞/巨噬细胞在协调促纤维化免疫微环境中的参与情况。外周血流式细胞术分析显示,与健康对照(HC)相比,慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染(CHI)患者和HBV相关肝硬化(LC)患者的IFNLR1+单核细胞升高。这些细胞还表现出 CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi 表型和 IL-10hiTNF-αhi 细胞因子谱。使用四氯化碳和重组腺相关病毒 8-1.3HBV 在野生型和 Ifnlr1 敲除 (Ifnlr1-/-) 小鼠中诱导肝纤维化。Ifnlr1缺陷下调单核细胞/巨噬细胞上的CCR2和CCR5表达,减弱胶原蛋白沉积,但增强HBV-DNA复制。在体外,将骨髓源性巨噬细胞 (BMDM) 与肝星状细胞 (HSC) 或初始 CD4+ T 细胞共培养,以评估 IFNLR1+ 巨噬细胞的功能影响。同时,使用肝脏 X 受体 (LXR) 激动剂/拮抗剂检查了脂质代谢在 IFN-λ/IFNLR1 介导的巨噬细胞调节中的参与情况。Ifnlr1-/- BMDM 激活 HSC 和驱动调节性 T 细胞分化的能力减弱。从机制上讲,IFN-λ-IFNLR1信号传导抑制LXR依赖性脂质代谢,从而促进肿瘤坏死因子(TNF)-α和IL-1β的产生,并且LXR通路抑制有利于M1巨噬细胞极化。总的来说,IFNLR1 识别出促纤维化和免疫调节的单核细胞/巨噬细胞亚群。靶向 IFNLR1-LXR 轴可能是治疗 HBV 相关肝纤维化的有前景的抗纤维化策略。

title: Trends in hepatitis B virus seroprevalence in a large cohort of adult cancer patients from 2010 to 2023.
abstract: PURPOSE: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses increased risks for cancer patients due to immunosuppression and potential viral reactivation. We evaluated the seroprevalence and temporal trends of HBV exposure in a large cohort of cancer patients in Brazil. METHODS: Adult patients who underwent anti-HBc testing at a quaternary oncology center between 2010 and 2023 were included in this retrospective study, and HBV exposure was defined as anti-HBc positivity. Temporal trends were assessed by using linear regression, whereas associated factors were evaluated by using multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: Anti-HBc testing was performed in 22.9% (28,869/125,985) of admitted cancer patients, and seroprevalence was 13.4% (3,857/28,869), declining from 16.5 in 2010 to 9.9% in 2023 (p < 0.001). Decreasing trends were observed across sexes and age groups (p < 0.001 for both), with a more pronounced decline among men (25.1%-12.3%). Seroprevalence also decreased significantly among White patients (16.7%-7.9%; p < 0.001) and those with solid tumors (18.8%-9.0%; p < 0.001), but not among non-White individuals (21.4%-17.7%; p = 0.246) or those with hematological malignancies (13.1%-12.8%; p = 0.136). Age ≥ 60 years (OR = 4.40; 95%CI: 3.77-5.12; p < 0.001), men (OR = 1.89; 95%CI: 1.76-2.04; p < 0.001), and non-White ethnicity/color (OR = 1.25; 95%CI: 1.15-1.35; p < 0.001) were independently associated with HBV exposure. CONCLUSION: Despite the declining seroprevalence over time, HBV exposure remains common among cancer patients, as persistent disparities across demographic groups underscore the need for expanded vaccination and systematic screening.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究纳入了2010年至2023年间在四级肿瘤中心接受抗-HBc检测的成年患者,HBV暴露被定义为抗-HBc阳性。

title_zh: 2010 年至 2023 年大量成人癌症患者中 乙型肝炎病毒 血清流行率 的趋势。
source_body_en: PURPOSE: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses increased risks for cancer patients due to immunosuppression and potential viral reactivation. We evaluated the seroprevalence and temporal trends of HBV exposure in a large cohort of cancer patients in Brazil. METHODS: Adult patients who underwent anti-HBc testing at a quaternary oncology center between 2010 and 2023 were included in this retrospective study, and HBV exposure was defined as anti-HBc positivity. Temporal trends were assessed by using linear regression, whereas associated factors were evaluated by using multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: Anti-HBc testing was performed in 22.9% (28,869/125,985) of admitted cancer patients, and seroprevalence was 13.4% (3,857/28,869), declining from 16.5 in 2010 to 9.9% in 2023 (p < 0.001). Decreasing trends were observed across sexes and age groups (p < 0.001 for both), with a more pronounced decline among men (25.1%-12.3%). Seroprevalence also decreased significantly among White patients (16.7%-7.9%; p < 0.001) and those with solid tumors (18.8%-9.0%; p < 0.001), but not among non-White individuals (21.4%-17.7%; p = 0.246) or those with hematological malignancies (13.1%-12.8%; p = 0.136). Age ≥ 60 years (OR = 4.40; 95%CI: 3.77-5.12; p < 0.001), men (OR = 1.89; 95%CI: 1.76-2.04; p < 0.001), and non-White ethnicity/color (OR = 1.25; 95%CI: 1.15-1.35; p < 0.001) were independently associated with HBV exposure. CONCLUSION: Despite the declining seroprevalence over time, HBV exposure remains common among cancer patients, as persistent disparities across demographic groups underscore the need for expanded vaccination and systematic screening.

title: A retrospective study of HIV and hepatitis B co-infection at a tertiary hospital in the Western Cape province of South Africa
abstract: Background: HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) coinfection is a clinical concern because of shared transmission routes and accelerated liver disease progression. Data from sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) remain limited. Objectives: To describe the clinical, laboratory, radiological, and outcome characteristics of adults with chronic HIV/HBV coinfection attending a tertiary hospital in South Africa. Method: A retrospective observational study of adults with HIV and chronic HBV infection attending an infectious diseases clinic between 01 January 2019 and 31 October 2024. Chronic HBV was defined as hepatitis B surface antigen positivity for at least 6 months. Eligible patients had at least two clinic visits. Data were extracted from clinical, laboratory, imaging, and pharmacy records. Results: Of the 179 patients screened, 140 met inclusion criteria. The cohort had a female predominance of 51.4% and a median age of 42 years; most were diagnosed through routine HIV care. The median CD4 count was 214 cells/μL, and many had advanced immunosuppression. Most were receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART), with 78.8% on tenofovir (TDF)-based regimens. HIV and HBV viral load (VL) was low, and the median HBV VL was 81 IU/mL. Liver assessment showed that 36.3% had an abnormal Aspartate Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index score and 40.2% had an elevated liver stiffness measurement (> 7 kPa) suggestive either of significant fibrosis or cirrhosis. Fifteen patients died, 3 of whom died from HBV-related causes. Retention in care was poor, with only one-third remaining in follow-up. Conclusion: Chronic HBV remains an important comorbidity among people living with HIV in South Africa, particularly in those born before widespread vaccination. Despite high ART coverage, important gaps remain in fibrosis assessment and retention in care. Strengthening prevention, vaccination, diagnostic access, and continuity of care is essential to reduce HBV-related morbidity and mortality.
journal: Southern African Journal of HIV Medicine

title_zh: 南非西开普省某三级医院艾滋病毒和乙型肝炎合并感染的回顾性研究
source_body_en: Background: HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) coinfection is a clinical concern because of shared transmission routes and accelerated liver disease progression. Data from sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) remain limited. Objectives: To describe the clinical, laboratory, radiological, and outcome characteristics of adults with chronic HIV/HBV coinfection attending a tertiary hospital in South Africa. Method: A retrospective observational study of adults with HIV and chronic HBV infection attending an infectious diseases clinic between 01 January 2019 and 31 October 2024. Chronic HBV was defined as hepatitis B surface antigen positivity for at least 6 months. Eligible patients had at least two clinic visits. Data were extracted from clinical, laboratory, imaging, and pharmacy records. Results: Of the 179 patients screened, 140 met inclusion criteria. The cohort had a female predominance of 51.4% and a median age of 42 years; most were diagnosed through routine HIV care. The median CD4 count was 214 cells/μL, and many had advanced immunosuppression. Most were receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART), with 78.8% on tenofovir (TDF)-based regimens. HIV and HBV viral load (VL) was low, and the median HBV VL was 81 IU/mL. Liver assessment showed that 36.3% had an abnormal Aspartate Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index score and 40.2% had an elevated liver stiffness measurement (> 7 kPa) suggestive either of significant fibrosis or cirrhosis. Fifteen patients died, 3 of whom died from HBV-related causes. Retention in care was poor, with only one-third remaining in follow-up. Conclusion: Chronic HBV remains an important comorbidity among people living with HIV in South Africa, particularly in those born before widespread vaccination. Despite high ART coverage, important gaps remain in fibrosis assessment and retention in care. Strengthening prevention, vaccination, diagnostic access, and continuity of care is essential to reduce HBV-related morbidity and mortality.

title: Evaluation of immune response to Hepatitis B vaccine: A cross-sectional study
abstract: Objectives Healthcare workers (HCWs) are often at constant risk of acquiring the hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection as an occupational hazard. This can be prevented not only with complete HBV vaccination, but also by estimation of the immune response to HBV surface antigen (HBsAg). This study aims to evaluate the immune response of vaccine-compliant HCWs in a tertiary care hospital. Material and Methods A cross-sectional study of 1.5 years duration was conducted among vaccine-compliant HCWs. Antibodies in response to HBs (anti-HBs) in their serum were assessed by quantitative enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results The results showed a significant number of HCWs (90.6%) with protective anti-HBs titre (≥10 mIU/mL). 9.4% HCWs were non-responders (anti-HBs <10 mIU/mL). There was a significant decrease in the number of HCWs with protective anti-HBs with an increase in time since last vaccination. Younger age at primary vaccination was associated with increased vaccine immunogenicity. Obesity alone and smoking combined with alcohol intake were contributors to decreased immune response. Conclusion The evaluation of immune response to HBV vaccine showed that 9% vaccine compliant HCWs did not have a protective anti-HBs titre. There was an inverse relationship between anti-HBs titre with time since vaccination and age at primary vaccination. Certain health conditions and lifestyles were shown to be associated with lowered immune response.
journal: Annals of the National Academy of Medical Sciences (India)

source_records.abstract: Objectives Healthcare workers (HCWs) are often at constant risk of acquiring the hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection as an occupational hazard. This can be prevented not only with complete HBV vaccination, but also by estimation of the immune response to HBV surface antigen (HBsAg). This study aims to evaluate the immune response of vaccine-compliant HCWs in a tertiary care hospital. Material and Methods A cross-sectional study of 1.5 years duration was conducted among vaccine-compliant HCWs. Antibodies in response to HBs (anti-HBs) in their serum were assessed by quantitative enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results The results showed a significant number of HCWs (90.6%) with protective anti-HBs titre (≥10 mIU/mL). 9.4% HCWs were non-responders (anti-HBs <10 mIU/mL). There was a significant decrease in the number of HCWs with protective anti-HBs with an increase in time since last vaccination. Younger age at primary vaccination was associated with increased vaccine immunogenicity. Obesity alone and smoking combined with alcohol intake were contributors to decreased immune response. Conclusion The evaluation of immune response to HBV vaccine showed that 9% vaccine compliant HCWs did not have a protective anti-HBs titre. There was an inverse relationship between anti-HBs titre with time since vaccination and age at primary vaccination. Certain health conditions and lifestyles were shown to be associated with lowered immune response.

abstract_zh: 目标 医护人员 (HCW) 经常面临感染 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 职业危害的持续风险。这不仅可以通过完整的 HBV 免疫应答 来预防,还可以通过估计 免疫应答 与 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 来预防。本研究旨在评估三级医院中符合 疫苗 的医护人员的 免疫应答。材料和方法 在符合 疫苗 的医护人员中进行了为期 1.5 年的横断面研究。通过定量酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 评估血清中针对 HBs(抗 HBs)的抗体。结果 结果显示,大量医护人员 (90.6%) 具有保护性抗 HBs 滴度 (≥10 mIU/mL)。9.4% 的医护人员为无反应者(抗 HBs <10 mIU/mL)。自上次 疫苗接种 以来,随着时间的增加,具有保护性抗 HBs 的医护人员数量显着减少。初次 疫苗接种 年龄较小与 疫苗 免疫原性增加相关。单纯肥胖和吸烟加酒精摄入是导致 免疫应答 减少的因素。结论 免疫应答 对 HBV 疫苗 的评估表明,9% 符合 疫苗 的医护人员不具有保护性抗 HBs 滴度。抗-HBs滴度与疫苗接种以来的时间和初次疫苗接种时的年龄之间存在反比关系。某些健康状况和生活方式被证明与 免疫应答 降低有关。

title: Epidemiological dynamics and prevention strategies for viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic
abstract: Background Viral hepatitis B and C remain important public health concerns because of their potential progression to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Epidemiological monitoring, vaccination, screening, and early diagnosis are therefore essential for reducing transmission and disease burden. Assessing recent trends in the Kyrgyz Republic is particularly important for evaluating the effectiveness of national prevention programmes and identifying regional and demographic groups requiring additional interventions. Objective This study aimed to examine the epidemiological situation regarding acute and chronic viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023. Material and methods The study analysed data provided by the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service. Time trends, regional and demographic characteristics, and the outcomes of screening and vaccination programmes were evaluated. Results The incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3-fold during the study period, coinciding with the long-term implementation of mass vaccination introduced in 2000. New hepatitis B cases among children were virtually eliminated, supporting the effectiveness of childhood vaccination. In 2023, screening of 203,308 individuals detected infection markers in 2.82%, indicating a considerable burden of previously unidentified infections. The highest hepatitis B infection levels were recorded in Osh, Jalal-Abad, and Chui regions and in major cities. Adult vaccination introduced in 2023 achieved substantial coverage; however, only 58% of vaccinated individuals completed the three-dose schedule, highlighting the need to improve adherence. Expanded laboratory diagnostics and epidemiological surveillance also contributed to improved case detection. Conclusions The findings demonstrate progress in hepatitis prevention in the Kyrgyz Republic while identifying continuing gaps in vaccination completion, screening, and early diagnosis. Strengthening these measures, particularly in densely populated and high-incidence regions, may further reduce the national burden of viral hepatitis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Viral hepatitis B and C remain major public health concerns due to their potential progression to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (A1). The study aimed to examine the epidemiological situation of acute and chronic hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023 (A4).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined the epidemiological situation in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023, analysing surveillance data from the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service (A5) and evaluating time trends, regional and demographic characteristics (A6).
analysis.methods: Surveillance data were collected from the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service (A5) and analysed to assess time trends, regional and demographic characteristics, and the impact of screening and vaccination programmes (A6), while expanded laboratory diagnostics and enhanced epidemiological surveillance improved case detection (A12).
analysis.main_results: Incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3‐fold from 2018 to 2023, with near‐elimination of paediatric cases (A7, A8). Screening of 203,308 individuals in 2023 identified infection markers in 2.82% of people, the highest prevalence in Osh, Jalal‐Abad and Chui regions (A9, A10). Adult vaccination coverage reached 58% but only 58% completed the three‐dose schedule, highlighting adherence challenges (A11).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that hepatitis prevention in the Kyrgyz Republic has progressed, yet gaps persist in vaccination completion, screening and early diagnosis (A13).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore that epidemiological monitoring, vaccination, screening and early diagnosis are essential to reduce transmission and disease burden (A2). Evaluating recent trends helps assess the effectiveness of national prevention programmes, and strengthening measures in high‐incidence regions could further lower the national hepatitis burden (A3, A14).
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The analysis relies on surveillance data from the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service (A5), which may limit representativeness and introduce reporting bias, and because the evidence is abstract‐only, confidence is assessed as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: Viral hepatitis B and C remain major public health threats in the Kyrgyz Republic due to their potential to cause chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. This study examined the epidemiological situation of acute and chronic hepatitis B and C from 2018 to 2023, analysing surveillance data from the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service and assessing time trends, regional patterns and the outcomes of screening and vaccination programmes. Incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3‐fold during the period, paediatric cases were virtually eliminated, and screening of 203,308 individuals in 2023 identified infection markers in 2.82% of people, with the highest prevalence in Osh, Jalal‐Abad and Chui regions. Adult vaccination coverage reached 58% but only 58% completed the three‐dose schedule, highlighting adherence challenges. The authors conclude that while prevention efforts have advanced, gaps in vaccination completion, screening and early diagnosis persist, and strengthening these measures, especially in high‐incidence areas, could further reduce the national hepatitis burden.

title_zh: 吉尔吉斯共和国乙型和丙型病毒性肝炎流行病学动态及预防策略
source_body_en: Background Viral hepatitis B and C remain important public health concerns because of their potential progression to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Epidemiological monitoring, vaccination, screening, and early diagnosis are therefore essential for reducing transmission and disease burden. Assessing recent trends in the Kyrgyz Republic is particularly important for evaluating the effectiveness of national prevention programmes and identifying regional and demographic groups requiring additional interventions. Objective This study aimed to examine the epidemiological situation regarding acute and chronic viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023. Material and methods The study analysed data provided by the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service. Time trends, regional and demographic characteristics, and the outcomes of screening and vaccination programmes were evaluated. Results The incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3-fold during the study period, coinciding with the long-term implementation of mass vaccination introduced in 2000. New hepatitis B cases among children were virtually eliminated, supporting the effectiveness of childhood vaccination. In 2023, screening of 203,308 individuals detected infection markers in 2.82%, indicating a considerable burden of previously unidentified infections. The highest hepatitis B infection levels were recorded in Osh, Jalal-Abad, and Chui regions and in major cities. Adult vaccination introduced in 2023 achieved substantial coverage; however, only 58% of vaccinated individuals completed the three-dose schedule, highlighting the need to improve adherence. Expanded laboratory diagnostics and epidemiological surveillance also contributed to improved case detection. Conclusions The findings demonstrate progress in hepatitis prevention in the Kyrgyz Republic while identifying continuing gaps in vaccination completion, screening, and early diagnosis. Strengthening these measures, particularly in densely populated and high-incidence regions, may further reduce the national burden of viral hepatitis.
abstract_zh: 背景病毒乙型和丙型肝炎仍然是重要的公共卫生问题,因为它们可能发展为慢性肝病、肝硬化和肝细胞癌。因此,流行病学监测、传播、筛查和早期 诊断 对于减少 传播 和疾病负担至关重要。评估吉尔吉斯共和国最近的趋势对于评估国家预防计划的有效性和确定需要额外干预的区域和人口群体尤其重要。目的 本研究旨在了解吉尔吉斯斯坦共和国 2018 年至 2023 年急慢性乙型和丙型病毒性肝炎的流行病学状况。材料和方法本研究分析了疾病预防部门和国家卫生流行病学服务机构 监测 提供的数据。对时间趋势、区域和人口特征以及筛查和 疫苗接种 计划的结果进行了评估。结果 乙型肝炎发病率在研究期间下降了2.3倍,与2000年开始实施的大规模发病率的长期实施相吻合。儿童乙型肝炎新发病例几乎被消除,支持了儿童疫苗接种的有效性。2023年,对203,308人的筛查发现了2.82%的感染标志物,这表明先前未发现的感染负担相当大。奥什、贾拉拉巴德和崔地区以及主要城市的乙型肝炎感染水平最高。2023年推出的成人疫苗接种实现大幅覆盖;然而,只有 58% 的接种者完成了三剂疫苗接种计划,这凸显了提高依从性的必要性。扩大实验室诊断和流行病学 监测 也有助于改进病例检测。结论 研究结果表明吉尔吉斯斯坦共和国在肝炎预防方面取得了进展,同时确定了 疫苗接种 完成、筛查和早期 诊断 方面持续存在的差距。加强这些措施,特别是在人口稠密和发病率高的地区,可能会进一步减轻国家病毒性肝炎的负担。

title: Prevalence and Genetic Diversity of Hepatitis B and C Viruses in People Living with HIV in the Capital District of Venezuela
abstract: Coinfection between hepatitis viruses and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) significantly increases liver disease and AIDS progression. This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated the prevalence and genetic diversity of hepatitis B (HBV) and C viruses (HCV) among people living with HIV (PLWH) in Venezuela’s Capital District. A total of 420 serum samples collected between 2022 and 2025 were tested for serological and molecular markers, including whole-genome HBV sequencing via next-generation sequencing (NGS) to characterize viral genotype distribution and mutations. Seroprevalences for HBsAg, anti-HBc, and anti-HCV were 2.9%, 20%, and 4.0%, respectively. HBV exposure was significantly higher in older men, with no differences between treatment-naïve and treated patients. Occult HBV infection (OBI) prevalence decreased compared to 2014 data (seropositive: 7% vs. 16%, seronegative: 0.9% vs. This decline, along with the higher HBV exposure among older adults, may be partially attributed to the universal HBV vaccination introduced in Venezuela in 1998, as well as modifications in antiretroviral therapy affecting HBV replication. Notably, key vaccine- and diagnostic-escape mutations were detected in OBI cases, highlighting clinical and public health concerns. Increased HCV prevalence appears to be linked to rising intravenous drug use in the country. HBV phylogenetic analysis revealed genotype F3 as predominant, followed by F1b (Cosmopolitan clade), while HCV showed genotype 1a to be the most frequent, followed by 1b and 3a. These findings underscore the success of immunization efforts but highlight the urgent need for continuous molecular surveillance and updated public health policies, including targeted harm-reduction programs, to control viral hepatitis in vulnerable populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估委内瑞拉首都区艾滋病毒感染者的 患病率 以及乙型和丙型肝炎病毒的遗传多样性,解决肝炎病毒和艾滋病毒混合感染这一重大公共卫生问题,这种感染会增加肝病和艾滋病的进展。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性横断面研究评估了 2022 年至 2025 年委内瑞拉首都区 420 名艾滋病毒感染者 (PLWH) 的 患病率 以及乙型肝炎 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的遗传多样性。
elements_zh.methods: 对 420 名感染者的血清样本进行了血清学和分子标记测试,包括通过新一代测序 (NGS) 进行全 基因组 HBV 测序,以表征病毒基因型分布和 基因组。
elements_zh.main_results: HBsAg、抗 HBc 和抗 HCV 的 血清流行率 分别为 2.9%、20% 和 4.0%。值得注意的是,与 2014 年数据相比,隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 的 患病率 有所下降,并且在 OBI 病例中检测到了关键的 疫苗 和诊断逃逸 突变。HCV 患病率 的增加与静脉注射毒品使用的增加有关。HBV 系统发育分析显示基因型 F3 占主导地位,其次是 F1b,而 HCV 显示基因型 1a 最为常见,其次是 1b 和 3a。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 老年男性的 HBV 暴露量显着较高,未接受 治疗 治疗的患者与接受治疗的患者之间没有差异。OBI 患病率 的下降和关键 突变 的检测突显了免疫工作的成功以及持续分子 监测 和更新公共卫生政策的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了免疫工作的成功,但也强调迫切需要连续分子 监测 和更新的公共卫生政策,包括有针对性的减少危害计划,以控制脆弱人群的病毒性肝炎。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的抽样偏差而受到限制。由于该研究的观察性质且缺乏随机对照试验,证据强度中等。

title: Hypovitaminosis D-Induced Secondary Hyperparathyroidism with Concomitant Femoral Fracture in a Chronic Hepatitis B Patient - A Case Report
abstract: Background: Vitamin D is essential for bone mineralisation and calcium-phosphate balance. Deficiency can cause secondary hyperparathyroidism and increase fracture risk. While its role in chronic hepatitis B (HBV) is not fully understood, low vitamin D levels are common in HBV patients. It has been postulated that HBV infection may alter vitamin D metabolism through impaired hydroxylation. In Ghana, despite abundant sunlight, Vitamin D deficiency rates remain high due to factors like skin pigmentation and low dietary intake. This case highlights metabolic bone disease in a non-cirrhotic HBV patient, emphasising the need for bone health assessment in this population. Case Presentation: A 39-year-old man with HBV infection, diagnosed in 2013, who was poorly adherent to antiviral therapy, presented with a painful, deformed left thigh following a low-energy fall. He denied alcohol, tobacco use, or prior fractures. Examination revealed a swollen, tender, and twisted left thigh with palpable bony crepitus and preserved distal neurovascular function. X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density. Laboratory investigations were consistent with secondary hyperparathyroidism due to severe vitamin D deficiency, evidenced by low serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1ng/mL ( 1230 U/L. Other laboratory results included elevated HBV DNA of 1040 IU/mL while serum calcium, magnesium, renal function, thyroid profile, and full blood count results were within normal limits. Bone histopathology showed callus formation with chronic inflammation, consistent with a healing fracture.
journal: African Journal of Current Medical Research

analysis.research_question_and_background: This case report investigates the association between hepatitis B virus infection and metabolic bone disease, particularly hypovitaminosis D-induced secondary hyperparathyroidism with femoral fracture.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 39-year-old man with chronic hepatitis B virus infection, diagnosed in 2013, who presented with a femoral fracture following a low-energy fall.
analysis.methods: The patient's clinical presentation, laboratory investigations, and imaging were used to assess vitamin D levels, bone density, and signs of secondary hyperparathyroidism.
analysis.main_results: Laboratory findings revealed a severe vitamin D deficiency with a serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1 ng/mL, and X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case highlights the potential role of hepatitis B virus infection in altering vitamin D metabolism, leading to secondary hyperparathyroidism and increased fracture risk, even in the absence of cirrhosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of assessing bone health in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus infection, particularly in populations with high rates of vitamin D deficiency.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a case report, the study lacks generalisability and cannot establish causality, but the evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that HBV infection may contribute to metabolic bone disease.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with chronic hepatitis B virus infection who presented with a femoral fracture. Laboratory investigations revealed severe vitamin D deficiency and signs of secondary hyperparathyroidism. The case highlights the potential link between HBV infection and metabolic bone disease, even in non-cirrhotic patients. The findings suggest the need for routine bone health assessments in individuals with chronic HBV infection, particularly in regions with high vitamin D deficiency rates. However, as a case report, the study has limited generalisability and cannot establish causality. title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 患者中维生素 D 缺乏引起的继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症并伴有股骨骨折 - 病例报告
source_body_en: Background: Vitamin D is essential for bone mineralisation and calcium-phosphate balance. Deficiency can cause secondary hyperparathyroidism and increase fracture risk. While its role in chronic hepatitis B (HBV) is not fully understood, low vitamin D levels are common in HBV patients. It has been postulated that HBV infection may alter vitamin D metabolism through impaired hydroxylation. In Ghana, despite abundant sunlight, Vitamin D deficiency rates remain high due to factors like skin pigmentation and low dietary intake. This case highlights metabolic bone disease in a non-cirrhotic HBV patient, emphasising the need for bone health assessment in this population. Case Presentation: A 39-year-old man with HBV infection, diagnosed in 2013, who was poorly adherent to antiviral therapy, presented with a painful, deformed left thigh following a low-energy fall. He denied alcohol, tobacco use, or prior fractures. Examination revealed a swollen, tender, and twisted left thigh with palpable bony crepitus and preserved distal neurovascular function. X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density. Laboratory investigations were consistent with secondary hyperparathyroidism due to severe vitamin D deficiency, evidenced by low serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1ng/mL ( 1230 U/L. Other laboratory results included elevated HBV DNA of 1040 IU/mL while serum calcium, magnesium, renal function, thyroid profile, and full blood count results were within normal limits. Bone histopathology showed callus formation with chronic inflammation, consistent with a healing fracture.
abstract_zh: 背景:维生素 D 对于骨矿化和钙磷平衡至关重要。缺乏会导致继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进并增加骨折风险。虽然维生素 D 在 慢性乙型肝炎 (HBV) 中的作用尚不完全清楚,但维生素 D 水平低在 HBV 患者中很常见。据推测,乙型肝炎病毒感染可能通过羟基化受损而改变维生素 D 代谢。在加纳,尽管阳光充足,但由于皮肤色素沉着和饮食摄入量低等因素,维生素 D 缺乏率仍然很高。该病例强调了非肝硬化乙型肝炎患者的代谢性骨病,强调了对该人群进行骨骼健康评估的必要性。病例介绍:一名 39 岁男性,患有 HBV 感染,于 2013 年诊断,他对 抗病毒药物 治疗的依从性较差,低能量跌倒后出现左大腿疼痛、变形。他否认饮酒、吸烟或曾骨折。检查发现左大腿肿胀、压痛、扭曲,可触及骨性捻发音,远端神经血管功能完好。X 射线成像显示闭合性左股骨粗隆下股骨骨折,并伴有骨密度降低的迹象。实验室检查与严重维生素 D 缺乏导致的继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症一致,血清 25(OH)D 水平低至 8.1 ng/mL(1230 U/L)。其他实验室结果包括 HBV DNA 升高 1040 IU/mL,而血清钙、镁、肾功能、甲状腺特征和全血计数结果均在正常范围内。骨组织病理学显示骨痂形成伴有慢性炎症,与愈合骨折一致。

title: Assessing the relationship between chronic aflatoxin exposure and hepatitis B virus immune protection in a population of children receiving nutritional support in Rwanda
abstract: Chronic aflatoxins exposure may impair immune function, but evidence in African children is limited. We assessed their association with hepatitis B surface antibody (Anti-HBs) levels in Rwandan children receiving nutritional support for malnutrition recovery or prevention. A total of 216 children aged 7–59 months were enrolled, including 70 malnutrition cases and 146 controls. Anti-HBs concentrations were measured using the ARCHITECT System (Abbott Diagnostics), and aflatoxins (AFB1, AFB2, AFG1, AFG2 and AFB1-lysine) were quantified by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS). Anti-HBs levels were highly variable (median = 84.8 IU/ml, IQR 14.0–283.4). Serum analysis for AFB1-lysine revealed a mean concentration of 23.43 ± 5.76 pg/mg albumin, while none of the samples showed detectable levels of AFB1, AFB2, AFG1, or AFG2 above the limit of detection. In unadjusted analyses, no significant differences in Anti-HBs or aflatoxin levels were observed between cases and controls (Mann–Whitney U, p = 0.452 and p = 0.119, respectively) or between sexs (t-test, p = 0.642 and p = 0.352). Age was not correlated with aflatoxin levels (r = 0.06, p = 0.556). In multivariable linear regression analyses adjusting for age, place of residence, socioeconomic status, and sex, nutritional status emerged as a significant determinant of Anti-HBs levels. Specifically, the control group had higher Anti-HBs levels than the case group (β = 0.573, 95% CI 0.076–1.070, p = 0.024), while aflatoxin exposure showed no independent association with Anti-HBs levels (β = − 0.003, 95% CI − 0.031–0.025, p = 0.832). These findings suggest that, in this population, nutritional status rather than chronic aflatoxins burden, is the primary determinant of Anti-HBs response, highlighting the importance of targeted nutritional interventions to support immune protection in children.

title: Updated Hepatitis D Seroprevalence Among Hepatitis B Surface Antigen-Positive Persons Aged ≥6 Years in the United States, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 2007‒2018.

title: In silico-based Exploration of Moringa oleifera Phytochemicals as Potential Inhibitors of the Hepatitis B Virus X Protein
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health concern. The HBV X protein (HBx) plays an important role in viral gene regulation and replication and represents a potential molecular target for antiviral compound screening. Aim: This study evaluated the predicted interactions of selected Moringa oleifera phytochemicals with HBx using in silico approaches. Materials and Methods: Five M. oleifera phytochemicals (quercetin, rutin, chlorogenic acid, gallic acid, and moringin) and gambogic acid, used as a reference compound, were evaluated against HBx. Toxicity profiles were predicted using ProTox-II, while molecular docking was performed using PyRx. Protein–ligand interactions were subsequently analyzed using BIOVIA Discovery Studio. Results: All six compounds were predicted to be inactive for hepatotoxicity. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, moringin and gambogic acid were predicted to be inactive across all assessed toxicity endpoints. These compounds also showed favourable predicted binding affinities in PyRx, with interactions involving key HBx residues, including Leu93, Pro90 and Thr97. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin exhibited particularly favourable predicted interactions with the HBx binding site. Conclusion: The in silico analysis identified several M. oleifera phytochemicals with favourable predicted toxicity profiles and interactions with HBx, particularly rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin. These findings suggest that these compounds may interact with HBx and potentially modulate HBx-associated molecular processes. However, experimental studies are required to validate these computational predictions and determine their biological relevance.
journal: International Journal of Biochemistry Research & Review

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题。HBV X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒基因调控和复制中发挥着重要作用,是 抗病毒药物 化合物筛选的潜在分子靶标。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用计算机方法评估了选定的辣木植物化学物质与 HBx 的预测相互作用。使用五种辣木植物化学物质(槲皮素、芦丁、绿原酸、没食子酸和辣木苷)和藤黄酸作为参考化合物,针对 HBx 进行评估。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ProTox-II 预测毒性特征,同时使用 PyRx 进行分子对接。随后使用 BIOVIA Discovery Studio 分析蛋白质-配体相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 预计所有六种化合物均无肝毒性。芦丁、绿原酸、辣木苷和藤黄酸预计在所有评估的毒性终点均无活性。这些化合物还在 PyRx 中表现出良好的预测结合亲和力,相互作用涉及关键 HBx 残基,包括 Leu93、Pro90 和 Thr97。芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素与 HBx 结合位点表现出特别有利的预测相互作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明这些化合物可能与 HBx 相互作用并可能调节 HBx 相关的分子过程。计算机分析确定了几种具有良好预测毒性特征以及与 HBx 相互作用的辣木植物化学物质,特别是芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素。

title_zh: 辣木植物化学物质作为 乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白潜在抑制剂的计算机模拟探索
source_body_en: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health concern. The HBV X protein (HBx) plays an important role in viral gene regulation and replication and represents a potential molecular target for antiviral compound screening. Aim: This study evaluated the predicted interactions of selected Moringa oleifera phytochemicals with HBx using in silico approaches. Materials and Methods: Five M. oleifera phytochemicals (quercetin, rutin, chlorogenic acid, gallic acid, and moringin) and gambogic acid, used as a reference compound, were evaluated against HBx. Toxicity profiles were predicted using ProTox-II, while molecular docking was performed using PyRx. Protein–ligand interactions were subsequently analyzed using BIOVIA Discovery Studio. Results: All six compounds were predicted to be inactive for hepatotoxicity. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, moringin and gambogic acid were predicted to be inactive across all assessed toxicity endpoints. These compounds also showed favourable predicted binding affinities in PyRx, with interactions involving key HBx residues, including Leu93, Pro90 and Thr97. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin exhibited particularly favourable predicted interactions with the HBx binding site. Conclusion: The in silico analysis identified several M. oleifera phytochemicals with favourable predicted toxicity profiles and interactions with HBx, particularly rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin. These findings suggest that these compounds may interact with HBx and potentially modulate HBx-associated molecular processes. However, experimental studies are required to validate these computational predictions and determine their biological relevance.
abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题。HBV X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒基因调控和复制中发挥着重要作用,是 抗病毒药物 化合物筛选的潜在分子靶标。目的:本研究使用计算机方法评估了选定的辣木植物化学物质与 HBx 的预测相互作用。材料和方法:使用五种油橄榄植物化学物质(槲皮素、芦丁、绿原酸、没食子酸和辣木苷)和藤黄酸作为参考化合物,针对 HBx 进行评估。使用 ProTox-II 预测毒性特征,同时使用 PyRx 进行分子对接。随后使用 BIOVIA Discovery Studio 分析蛋白质-配体相互作用。结果:预计所有六种化合物均无肝毒性。芦丁、绿原酸、辣木苷和藤黄酸预计在所有评估的毒性终点均无活性。这些化合物还在 PyRx 中表现出良好的预测结合亲和力,相互作用涉及关键 HBx 残基,包括 Leu93、Pro90 和 Thr97。芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素与 HBx 结合位点表现出特别有利的预测相互作用。结论:计算机分析确定了几种具有良好预测毒性特征以及与 HBx 相互作用的油橄榄植物化学物质,特别是芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素。这些发现表明这些化合物可能与 HBx 相互作用并可能调节 HBx 相关的分子过程。然而,需要实验研究来验证这些计算预测并确定它们的生物学相关性。

title: Biological interpretation of baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and cirrhosis in determining interferon treatment duration
abstract: The recent identification of baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and cirrhosis as independent predictors of extended interferon therapy provides a valuable clinical framework, yet the biological mechanisms underlying these associations require further elucidation. In this opinion review, we interpret these factors not merely as statistical covariates but as pathological surrogates for the virus-host equilibrium. We propose that high baseline hepatitis B surface antigen may reflect a deeply entrenched intrahepatic viral reservoir and may create an antigen-rich environment that impairs effective antiviral immunity. Concurrently, cirrhosis may be better understood as a spectrum of architectural remodeling in which vascular changes and sinusoidal defenestration could limit immune surveillance and affect local therapeutic access. Consequently, treatment durations exceeding 48 weeks may be required, at least in part, to overcome these profound immunological and structural barriers. We advocate shifting future predictive modeling from binary clinical definitions to a granular integration of viral kinetics and histological morphology to refine precision medicine in chronic hepatitis B.

title: Further evidence of hepatitis D occurring in the absence of hepatitis B
abstract: The transmission of hepatitis D virus (HDV) requires a helper virus, hepatitis B virus (HBV) being the established companion. However, recent evidence suggests that HDV and other kolmioviruses might utilize a broader range of helper viruses, raising the possibility of unidentified disease associations. We screened anti-HDV antibodies (anti-HDV) from 2121 serum/plasma specimens, representing 1996 patients, selected from samples sent for routine diagnostic testing of various infectious and autoimmune diseases to the Virology and Immunology laboratory at HUS Diagnostic Center, Helsinki, Finland in 2021 -2022. This led to detection of anti-HDV in 20/1996 (1.0%) of patients, of which 17 were negative for both HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) and HBV DNA. Of these 17 patients, 16 were negative in HDV RNA detection, and 1 patient was HDV RNA positive. The HDV RNA positive patient was confirmed to be negative for HBV core total antibody, but positive for anti-HCV antibodies and HCV RNA. This serosurvey suggests HDV infections may occur outside HBV carriers.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether hepatitis D virus (HDV) infections can occur independently of hepatitis B virus (HBV), challenging the established view that HDV requires HBV as a helper virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A serosurvey was conducted using 2121 serum/plasma specimens from 1996 patients, collected between 2021 and 2022 at the Virology and Immunology laboratory at HUS Diagnostic Center, Helsinki, Finland, for routine diagnostic testing of various infectious and autoimmune diseases.
analysis.methods: Anti-HDV antibodies were screened from the specimens, and HDV RNA detection was performed on 17 patients who were negative for both HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) and HBV DNA.
analysis.main_results: Anti-HDV was detected in 1.0% of patients (20/1996), with 17 of these patients being negative for HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) and HBV DNA. Of these 17, 16 were negative for HDV RNA, and 1 was positive for HDV RNA.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HDV infections may occur in the absence of HBV, indicating a potential for HDV to infect individuals without HBV co-infection, which is a novel observation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of more comprehensive surveillance and diagnostic strategies for HDV, particularly in populations where HBV co-infection is not present.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on routine diagnostic samples, which may introduce selection bias, and the small number of HDV RNA-positive cases, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study challenges the established view that hepatitis D virus (HDV) requires hepatitis B virus (HBV) as a helper virus by demonstrating that HDV infections can occur independently of HBV. A serosurvey of 1996 patients revealed that 1.0% had anti-HDV antibodies, with 17 being negative for HBV markers. Among these, 16 were negative for HDV RNA, and 1 was positive. The HDV RNA-positive patient was also positive for hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibodies and HCV RNA, suggesting a possible association with HCV. These findings indicate that HDV infections may occur outside of HBV carriers, which has implications for surveillance and diagnosis. However, the study's reliance on routine diagnostic samples and the small number of HDV RNA-positive cases limit the confidence in the results, leading to a moderate assessment of evidence strength.

title: Hepatitis B elimination in Africa by 2030 requires urgent scale up of birth dose vaccination, maternal antiviral prophylaxis and political action
abstract: Hepatitis B elimination in Africa is unlikely to be achieved by 2030 unless prevention and care systems are urgently strengthened. Despite progress in infant vaccination, the World Health Organization (WHO) African Region continues to have very low timely hepatitis B birth-dose coverage and major gaps in diagnosis and treatment. Routine antenatal screening for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), timely birth-dose vaccination, and access to maternal antiviral prophylaxis remain insufficient, allowing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) to sustain new chronic infections. Elimination therefore requires an integrated package: vaccination within 24 h of birth, including community delivery for non-facility births; maternal screening and tenofovir prophylaxis where indicated; decentralized diagnosis and treatment; reliable financing and supplies; and surveillance. Recent international support for hepatitis B birth-dose introduction creates an important implementation opportunity, but political commitment will be essential to translate policy into coverage.

They assess the coverage of birth-dose vaccination, maternal antiviral prophylaxis, and the availability of decentralized diagnosis and treatment.

They stress the importance of political commitment to implement these strategies effectively. title: Development and internal validation of a CatBoost–SHAP-guided nomogram for significant liver fibrosis in children with chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Background Significant liver fibrosis can develop in children with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet liver biopsy is invasive and unsuitable for repeated assessment. We developed an interpretable, non-invasive prediction model for significant fibrosis in pediatric CHB and evaluated whether baseline risk stratification was associated with subsequent treatment outcomes. Methods This retrospective study included 232 children with CHB who underwent liver biopsy, with significant fibrosis defined as Scheuer stage S ≥ 2. Patients were randomly assigned to a development cohort (80%) and a held-out test set (20%). A CatBoost model with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization was used to identify the most informative predictors, and these variables were incorporated into a logistic regression nomogram guided by Shapley additive explanations (SHAP). Model performance was evaluated by discrimination, calibration, decision curve analysis, and DeLong testing. Associations between baseline risk groups and longitudinal outcomes were examined using generalized estimating equations adjusted for age and sex and Kaplan–Meier analyses. Results Significant fibrosis was identified in 96 children (41.4%). Liver stiffness measurement, alanine aminotransferase, and platelet count were retained in the final model. The nomogram achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.828 (95% CI, 0.767–0.889) in the development cohort and 0.782 (95% CI, 0.637–0.927) in the held-out test cohort, with performance comparable to that of the CatBoost model ( P = 0.240). Compared with the low-risk group, high-risk patients showed greater longitudinal reductions in alanine and aspartate aminotransferase, whereas longitudinal changes in liver stiffness measurement and hepatitis B virus DNA were similar between groups. Conversely, low-risk patients achieved virological suppression, HBeAg seroconversion, and biochemical response earlier than those classified as high risk. Conclusions An interpretable three-variable prediction model based on CatBoost-guided feature selection accurately identified significant fibrosis in children with CHB while maintaining performance comparable to the machine-learning model. Baseline risk stratification was also associated with subsequent treatment outcomes, although external validation is needed before clinical implementation.
