title: Resolved hepatitis B is associated with higher reactivation risk than chronic infection after chemoembolization for hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: BACKGROUND Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a cornerstone treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation risk, particularly among patients with prior infection, remains incompletely characterized, with international guidelines providing discordant risk classifications. We hypothesized that patients with resolved HBV infection undergoing TACE face a higher reactivation risk than currently estimated by international guidelines. AIM To determine the incidence and risk factors of HBV reactivation in patients undergoing TACE for HBV-related HCC. METHODS We retrospectively analyzed patients who underwent TACE for HBV-related HCC at a tertiary hospital during 2007-2025. Patients receiving baseline antiviral therapy were excluded. Patients with definitive serostatus (n = 774) were stratified into chronic-infection [hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive, n = 727] and resolved-infection (HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive, n = 47) groups. Cumulative incidences and risk factors were assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox regression, with robustness evaluated through multiple imputation, competing-risks, and antiviral-naive sensitivity analyses. RESULTS During a median follow-up of 16.7 months, HBV reactivation occurred in 60 patients (6.1% overall). Patients with resolved HBV status had a higher reactivation rate (21.3% vs 6.9%; P CONCLUSION HBV reactivation occurred in approximately 6% of patients undergoing TACE, with resolved infection status conferring > 3-fold higher risk and reactivation incidence exceeding 20%. These findings support prophylactic antiviral therapy rather than monitoring alone for HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive patients undergoing TACE.

title_zh: 乙肝清除后肝细胞癌经动脉化疗栓塞治疗后的再激活风险高于慢性感染
source_body_en: BACKGROUND Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a cornerstone treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation risk, particularly among patients with prior infection, remains incompletely characterized, with international guidelines providing discordant risk classifications. We hypothesized that patients with resolved HBV infection undergoing TACE face a higher reactivation risk than currently estimated by international guidelines. AIM To determine the incidence and risk factors of HBV reactivation in patients undergoing TACE for HBV-related HCC. METHODS We retrospectively analyzed patients who underwent TACE for HBV-related HCC at a tertiary hospital during 2007-2025. Patients receiving baseline antiviral therapy were excluded. Patients with definitive serostatus (n = 774) were stratified into chronic-infection [hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive, n = 727] and resolved-infection (HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive, n = 47) groups. Cumulative incidences and risk factors were assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox regression, with robustness evaluated through multiple imputation, competing-risks, and antiviral-naive sensitivity analyses. RESULTS During a median follow-up of 16.7 months, HBV reactivation occurred in 60 patients (6.1% overall). Patients with resolved HBV status had a higher reactivation rate (21.3% vs 6.9%; P CONCLUSION HBV reactivation occurred in approximately 6% of patients undergoing TACE, with resolved infection status conferring > 3-fold higher risk and reactivation incidence exceeding 20%. These findings support prophylactic antiviral therapy rather than monitoring alone for HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive patients undergoing TACE.
abstract_zh: 背景 经动脉化疗栓塞(TACE)是肝细胞癌(HCC)的基石治疗,然而乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)再激活风险,尤其是在既往感染患者中,仍未被完全阐明,国际指南对其风险分类存在不一致。我们假设,既往感染已解决的HBV患者接受TACE后的再激活风险高于国际指南目前的估计。目的 确定接受TACE治疗HBV相关HCC患者的HBV再激活发病率和危险因素。方法 我们回顾性分析了2007-2025年间在三级医院接受TACE治疗的HBV相关HCC患者。接受基线抗病毒药物治疗的患者被排除。具有明确血清学状态的患者(n = 774)被分为慢性感染组[乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)阳性,n = 727]和已解决感染组(HBsAg阴性/抗乙型肝炎核心抗体阳性,n = 47)。累积发病率和危险因素采用Kaplan-Meier分析和Cox回归进行评估,稳健性通过多重插补、竞争风险和抗病毒药物无敏感性分析进行评价。结果 在中位随访16.7个月期间,HBV再激活发生在60例患者(总体6.1%)。已解决HBV状态的患者再激活率更高(21.3% 对比 6.9%;P < 0.001)。多因素分析确定已解决的HBV感染(调整风险比:3.42;95% CI:2.11-5.54;P < 0.001)为独立危险因素。结论 接受TACE的患者中约6%发生HBV再激活,已解决感染状态使风险增加超过3倍,再激活发病率超过20%。这些结果支持对HBsAg阴性/抗乙型肝炎核心抗体阳性且接受TACE的患者进行预防性抗病毒药物治疗,而非仅监测。

title: Associations of social support and disease-specific quality of life with self-management among patients with chronic hepatitis B: a multicenter cross-sectional study
abstract: Background Self-management behaviors are central to long-term care for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but the independent associations of social support and disease-specific quality-of-life domains with self-management remain unclear. This study assessed self-management and its associated factors among patients with CHB. Methods This multicenter cross-sectional study included 583 patients with CHB recruited by convenience sampling at three tertiary hospitals in Hengyang, China, from March to October 2025. Participants completed the Chronic Hepatitis B Self-Management Scale (CHBSMS), Social Support Rating Scale (SSRS), and Chronic Hepatitis B Quality of Life Instrument (CHBQOL). Hierarchical multiple linear regression, HC3 robust standard errors, and sensitivity analyses were used. Results The mean total CHBSMS score was 85.03 ± 19.38. The sociodemographic model yielded an R 2 of 0.194. Adding clinical and healthcare utilization factors increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.083), and adding social support and the four CHBQOL domain scores further increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.102), yielding a final R 2 of 0.379. In the fully adjusted model, social support ( B = 0.577, 95% CI: 0.416–0.739, p < 0.001), the emotional symptoms domain ( B = 0.170, 95% CI: 0.039–0.301, p = 0.011), and the social stigma domain ( B = 0.235, 95% CI: 0.082–0.388, p = 0.003) were positively associated with self-management scores. Higher scores in the latter two domains indicated fewer emotional symptoms and less social stigma, respectively. For a 1-SD higher value of each predictor, the corresponding CHBSMS differences were 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15 points for social support, emotional symptoms, and social stigma, respectively, equivalent to 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15% of the score range. The somatic symptoms and belief domains were not significantly associated with self-management. Robustness and sensitivity analyses did not materially alter the main findings. Conclusion Among patients with CHB recruited from three tertiary hospitals, social support, the emotional symptoms domain, and the social stigma domain were associated with self-management after adjustment for sociodemographic, clinical, and healthcare utilization factors. Further longitudinal research is needed to clarify the temporal direction and clinical relevance of these associations.

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的社会支持和疾病特异性生活质量与自我管理的关联:一项多中心横断面研究
source_body_en: Background Self-management behaviors are central to long-term care for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but the independent associations of social support and disease-specific quality-of-life domains with self-management remain unclear. This study assessed self-management and its associated factors among patients with CHB. Methods This multicenter cross-sectional study included 583 patients with CHB recruited by convenience sampling at three tertiary hospitals in Hengyang, China, from March to October 2025. Participants completed the Chronic Hepatitis B Self-Management Scale (CHBSMS), Social Support Rating Scale (SSRS), and Chronic Hepatitis B Quality of Life Instrument (CHBQOL). Hierarchical multiple linear regression, HC3 robust standard errors, and sensitivity analyses were used. Results The mean total CHBSMS score was 85.03 ± 19.38. The sociodemographic model yielded an R 2 of 0.194. Adding clinical and healthcare utilization factors increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.083), and adding social support and the four CHBQOL domain scores further increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.102), yielding a final R 2 of 0.379. In the fully adjusted model, social support ( B = 0.577, 95% CI: 0.416–0.739, p < 0.001), the emotional symptoms domain ( B = 0.170, 95% CI: 0.039–0.301, p = 0.011), and the social stigma domain ( B = 0.235, 95% CI: 0.082–0.388, p = 0.003) were positively associated with self-management scores. Higher scores in the latter two domains indicated fewer emotional symptoms and less social stigma, respectively. For a 1-SD higher value of each predictor, the corresponding CHBSMS differences were 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15 points for social support, emotional symptoms, and social stigma, respectively, equivalent to 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15% of the score range. The somatic symptoms and belief domains were not significantly associated with self-management. Robustness and sensitivity analyses did not materially alter the main findings. Conclusion Among patients with CHB recruited from three tertiary hospitals, social support, the emotional symptoms domain, and the social stigma domain were associated with self-management after adjustment for sociodemographic, clinical, and healthcare utilization factors. Further longitudinal research is needed to clarify the temporal direction and clinical relevance of these associations.

title: Seroprevalence and trends of transfusion-transmissible infections among blood donors in the Volta Region, Ghana: A four-year retrospective study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Blood transfusion is a life-saving intervention; however, transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and syphilis remain major public health concerns, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This study assessed the seroprevalence and temporal trends of TTIs among blood donors in the Volta Region of Ghana and to identify the demographic factors associated with seropositivity. METHODS: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from blood donors at Ho Teaching Hospital and Hohoe Regional Hospital between January 2020 and December 2023. Data from 6,147 eligible donors were extracted and analyzed using STATA version 17. Descriptive statistics summarized prevalence, while chi-square or Fisher's exact tests assessed associations. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with TTI seropositivity at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: A total of 6,147 blood donors were included in the analysis, of whom 95.1% were male. The overall prevalence of transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) was 8.1%, with syphilis (3.6%) being the most prevalent infection, followed by HBV (1.8%), HCV (1.8%), and HIV (1.0%). All infections peaked in 2022 before declining in 2023. Increasing age and year of donation were significantly associated with seropositivity for specific TTIs, particularly HBV, HCV, and syphilis. In Hohoe, male donors had significantly lower odds of HCV infection compared with female donors (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI: 0.06-0.28). CONCLUSIONS: Although TTI prevalence was relatively low, temporal increases and age-related disparities highlight the need for strengthened donor screening, targeted recruitment of voluntary donors, and enhanced surveillance strategies to ensure blood safety.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估加纳沃尔特地区献血者中输血传播感染 (TTI) 的 血清流行率 和时间趋势,并确定与血清阳性相关的人口因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2020 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间 Ho 教学医院和 Hohoe 地区医院献血者的二手数据进行了一项回顾性横断面研究。提取并分析了 6,147 名合格献血者的数据。
elements_zh.methods: 描述性统计总结了 患病率,而卡方或费舍尔精确检验则评估关联性。使用多变量逻辑回归以 5% 的显着性水平确定与 TTI 血清阳性相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 输血传播感染 (TTI) 的总体 患病率 为 8.1%,其中梅毒 (3.6%) 是最常见的感染,其次是 HBV (1.8%)、HCV (1.8%) 和 HIV (1.0%)。所有感染均于 2022 年达到顶峰,然后于 2023 年下降。年龄和捐赠年份的增加与特定 TTI(尤其是 HBV、HCV 和梅毒)的血清阳性显着相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,鉴于时间上的增加和与年龄相关的差异,需要加强捐献者筛选、有针对性地招募自愿捐献者以及加强 监测 策略以确保血液安全。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为有针对性的招募策略和 监测 计划提供信息,以降低加纳沃尔特地区通过输血感染 HBV 传播 的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于二手数据,这可能会限制数据质量和完整性。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它提供了对 TTI 患病率 和相关因素的直接观察。

title_zh: 加纳沃尔特地区献血者的 血清流行率 和输血传播感染趋势:一项为期四年的回顾性研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Blood transfusion is a life-saving intervention; however, transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and syphilis remain major public health concerns, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This study assessed the seroprevalence and temporal trends of TTIs among blood donors in the Volta Region of Ghana and to identify the demographic factors associated with seropositivity. METHODS: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from blood donors at Ho Teaching Hospital and Hohoe Regional Hospital between January 2020 and December 2023. Data from 6,147 eligible donors were extracted and analyzed using STATA version 17. Descriptive statistics summarized prevalence, while chi-square or Fisher's exact tests assessed associations. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with TTI seropositivity at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: A total of 6,147 blood donors were included in the analysis, of whom 95.1% were male. The overall prevalence of transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) was 8.1%, with syphilis (3.6%) being the most prevalent infection, followed by HBV (1.8%), HCV (1.8%), and HIV (1.0%). All infections peaked in 2022 before declining in 2023. Increasing age and year of donation were significantly associated with seropositivity for specific TTIs, particularly HBV, HCV, and syphilis. In Hohoe, male donors had significantly lower odds of HCV infection compared with female donors (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI: 0.06-0.28). CONCLUSIONS: Although TTI prevalence was relatively low, temporal increases and age-related disparities highlight the need for strengthened donor screening, targeted recruitment of voluntary donors, and enhanced surveillance strategies to ensure blood safety.
abstract_zh: 背景:输血是一种挽救生命的干预措施;然而,人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)和梅毒等输血传播感染(TTI)仍然是主要的公共卫生问题,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。本研究评估了加纳沃尔特地区献血者的 血清流行率 和 TTI 时间趋势,并确定与血清阳性相关的人口因素。方法:使用 2020 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间 Ho 教学医院和 Hohoe 地区医院献血者的二手数据进行了一项回顾性横断面研究。使用 STATA 版本 17 提取并分析了 6,147 名合格献血者的数据。描述性统计总结了 患病率,而卡方或 Fisher 精确检验评估了关联性。使用多变量逻辑回归以 5% 的显着性水平确定与 TTI 血清阳性相关的因素。结果:共有6147名献血者纳入分析,其中95.1%为男性。输血传播感染 (TTI) 的总体 患病率 为 8.1%,其中梅毒 (3.6%) 是最常见的感染,其次是 HBV (1.8%)、HCV (1.8%) 和 HIV (1.0%)。所有感染均于 2022 年达到顶峰,然后于 2023 年下降。年龄和捐赠年份的增加与特定 TTI(尤其是 HBV、HCV 和梅毒)的血清阳性显着相关。在 Hohoe,与女性捐赠者相比,男性捐赠者感染 HCV 的几率显着较低(aOR = 0.13;95% CI:0.06-0.28)。结论:虽然 TTI 患病率 相对较低,但时间上的增加和与年龄相关的差异突出表明需要加强捐献者筛选、有针对性地招募自愿捐献者以及加强 监测 策略以确保血液安全。

title: ESQUEMA DE VACUNACIÓN DEL PERSONAL SANITARIO PARA COVID-19, HEPATITIS B Y TÉTANOS DEL HOSPITAL GENERAL PEDIÁTRICO “NIÑOS DE ACOSTA ÑU” DE MARZO A ABRIL DEL 2023
abstract: Introduction: Infectious diseases constitute an important risk for healthcare personnel during the performance of their professional activities. However, in many cases, these diseases can be effectively prevented through systematic and preventive vaccination. Objective: To determine the frequency of healthcare personnel vaccinated against COVID-19, hepatitis B, and tetanus at the General Pediatric Hospital “Niños de Acosta Ñu” from March to April 2023. Methodology: A descriptive, non-experimental, quantitative, cross-sectional, and prospective study was conducted. The variables analyzed were age, sex, place of residence, length of employment, professional category, compliance with the vaccination schedule, occurrence of disease, type of disease, disease severity, and perception of vaccines. Data were collected using a digital Google Forms questionnaire, subsequently entered into Microsoft Excel 2016, and statistically analyzed using SPSS, version 21. The study protocol was approved by the Ethics Committee. Results: The mean age was 33 years (±5.5). Of the total participants, 83.1% (212/255) were female. Regarding place of residence, 57.3% (146/255) were from the Central Department. The median length of employment was 5 years (1–21). Regarding COVID-19 vaccination, 45.5% had completed the vaccination schedule, whereas 55.5% had an incomplete schedule. For hepatitis B, 85.9% (219/255) had completed the vaccination schedule. Regarding tetanus vaccination, 96.5% (246/255) had completed the vaccination schedule. Overall, 83.5% of the participants reported having contracted COVID-19, while 16.5% had not contracted the disease. Conclusion: The frequency of healthcare personnel at the General Pediatric Hospital “Niños de Acosta Ñu” with a complete COVID-19 vaccination schedule was low (45.5%), whereas the frequency of complete vaccination against hepatitis B (85.9%) and tetanus (96.5%) was high.

title_zh: ESQUEMA DE VACUNACIÓN DEL PERSONAL SANITARIO PARA COVID-19, HEPATITIS B Y TÉTANOS DEL HOSPITAL GENERAL PEDIÁTRICO “NIÑOS DE ACOSTA ÑU” DE MARZO A ABRIL DEL 2023
source_body_en: Introduction: Infectious diseases constitute an important risk for healthcare personnel during the performance of their professional activities. However, in many cases, these diseases can be effectively prevented through systematic and preventive vaccination. Objective: To determine the frequency of healthcare personnel vaccinated against COVID-19, hepatitis B, and tetanus at the General Pediatric Hospital “Niños de Acosta Ñu” from March to April 2023. Methodology: A descriptive, non-experimental, quantitative, cross-sectional, and prospective study was conducted. The variables analyzed were age, sex, place of residence, length of employment, professional category, compliance with the vaccination schedule, occurrence of disease, type of disease, disease severity, and perception of vaccines. Data were collected using a digital Google Forms questionnaire, subsequently entered into Microsoft Excel 2016, and statistically analyzed using SPSS, version 21. The study protocol was approved by the Ethics Committee. Results: The mean age was 33 years (±5.5). Of the total participants, 83.1% (212/255) were female. Regarding place of residence, 57.3% (146/255) were from the Central Department. The median length of employment was 5 years (1–21). Regarding COVID-19 vaccination, 45.5% had completed the vaccination schedule, whereas 55.5% had an incomplete schedule. For hepatitis B, 85.9% (219/255) had completed the vaccination schedule. Regarding tetanus vaccination, 96.5% (246/255) had completed the vaccination schedule. Overall, 83.5% of the participants reported having contracted COVID-19, while 16.5% had not contracted the disease. Conclusion: The frequency of healthcare personnel at the General Pediatric Hospital “Niños de Acosta Ñu” with a complete COVID-19 vaccination schedule was low (45.5%), whereas the frequency of complete vaccination against hepatitis B (85.9%) and tetanus (96.5%) was high.

title: Modeling and Analysis of SEIR Model of Hepatitis-\(B\) Virus via Fibonacci Wavelets
abstract: This study aims to examine the dynamics of susceptible, exposed, infected, and recovered individuals in the context of hepatitis-\(B\) model. This is achieved by developing an efficient numerical scheme based on Fibonacci wavelets for solving the hepatitis-\(B\) model. The proposed method employs operational matrices derived from Fibonacci wavelets to convert the given system of differential equations into a system of algebraic equations, solved via the Newton-Raphson method in MATLAB. The effects of hepatocyte death and virus production rates on healthy cells, infected cells, and viral load are analyzed to capture key aspects of disease progression. Comparative analysis with ND solve and Haar wavelet methods demonstrates that the proposed method yields accurate and efficient results. The numerical findings confirm the potential of Fibonacci wavelets as a reliable computational tool for studying infectious disease dynamics.
journal: International Journal of Analysis and Applications

title_zh: 基于斐波那契小波的乙型肝炎病毒 SEIR 模型建模与分析
source_body_en: This study aims to examine the dynamics of susceptible, exposed, infected, and recovered individuals in the context of hepatitis-\(B\) model. This is achieved by developing an efficient numerical scheme based on Fibonacci wavelets for solving the hepatitis-\(B\) model. The proposed method employs operational matrices derived from Fibonacci wavelets to convert the given system of differential equations into a system of algebraic equations, solved via the Newton-Raphson method in MATLAB. The effects of hepatocyte death and virus production rates on healthy cells, infected cells, and viral load are analyzed to capture key aspects of disease progression. Comparative analysis with ND solve and Haar wavelet methods demonstrates that the proposed method yields accurate and efficient results. The numerical findings confirm the potential of Fibonacci wavelets as a reliable computational tool for studying infectious disease dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在检查乙型肝炎模型中易感者、暴露者、感染者和康复者的动态。这是通过开发基于斐波那契小波的有效数值方案来解决肝炎-\(B\)模型来实现的。该方法采用斐波那契小波导出的运算矩阵将给定的微分方程组转换为代数方程组,并通过 MATLAB 中的牛顿-拉夫森方法求解。分析肝细胞死亡和病毒产生率对健康细胞、感染细胞和病毒载量的影响,以捕获疾病进展的关键方面。与ND求解和Haar小波方法的比较分析表明,该方法能产生准确、高效的结果。数值结果证实了斐波那契小波作为研究传染病动力学的可靠计算工具的潜力。

title: Predictive model to identify patients requiring extended interferon therapy in chronic hepatitis B
abstract: A contemporary study by Yan et al , published in the World Journal of Gastroen terology , demonstrates that baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and cirrhosis can be utilized in a prediction model to identify populations that may benefit from extended (≥ 48 weeks) interferon therapy. In this editorial, we summarize strengths of their study. First, the follow-up period was sufficiently long; second, the authors identified all major confounding factors; third, appropriate statistical methods were employed; fourth, the figures and tables are highly legible; and fifth, the training cohort exhibited stable discriminatory ability. The limitations of the study are as follows: First, the sample size in certain subgroups was too small; second, nearly all similar studies have been conducted in China, leaving readers with a limited understanding of global trends in this field; and third, the benefits of adding PEGylated interferon α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analog therapy were not addressed. Future research should investigate the promising role of combination therapies involving PEGylated interferon α-2b and nucleos(t)ide analogs, incorporate machine learning approaches, and consider the effects of concurrent nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.

abstract_zh: Yan 等人发表在《世界胃肠病学杂志》上的一项当代研究表明,可以在预测模型中利用基线乙型肝炎表面抗原和肝硬化来识别可能受益于延长(≥ 48 周)干扰素治疗的人群。在这篇社论中,我们总结了他们的研究优势。第一,随访时间足够长;其次,作者确定了所有主要的混杂因素;第三,采用适当的统计方法;第四,图表清晰易读;第五,训练后的队列研究表现出稳定的判别能力。该研究的局限性如下:首先,某些亚组的样本量过小;其次,几乎所有类似的研究都是在中国进行的,导致读者对该领域的全球趋势了解有限;第三,在核苷(酸)类似物疗法中添加聚乙二醇化干扰素α-2b的好处没有得到解决。未来的研究应该调查涉及聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2b 和核苷(酸)类似物的联合疗法的有前景的作用,结合机器学习方法,并考虑并发非酒精性脂肪肝疾病的影响。

title: A cross-sectional study of hepatitis B vaccination coverage and occupational risk exposure among health science students in a Nigerian University
abstract: Abstract Introduction Despite the presence of a safe and effective vaccine for hepatitis B virus (HBV), health science students remain at significant risk for infection. This study assessed HBV vaccination coverage, awareness, and associated factors among health science students at Usmanu Danfodiyo University in Sokoto, Nigeria. Methodology A cross-sectional study targeting 427 health science students was conducted at Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto between July 19 and September 10, 2025. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire assessing hepatitis B awareness, vaccination status, barriers, motivators, and occupational risks. Analysis used IBM SPSS version 25, with descriptive statistics, chi-square tests ( p < 0.05), and binary logistic regression, while the Hosmer–Lemeshow test and Nagelkerke R2 assessed model fit and explained variance. Results A total of 410 students participated (mean age 22.36 ± 2.94 years). Awareness of the hepatitis B vaccine was high (87.8%), but uptake was low (26.8%), only 12.2% were fully vaccinated, and 50.7% of unvaccinated students were willing to vaccinate. Key barriers included vaccine inaccessibility, cost, and limited information, while major motivators were prior exposure to infection (57.3%), institutional requirements (47.6%), and trust in public health institutions (43.9%). Occupational exposures were common, with poor post-exposure practices. Uptake was significantly associated with department and level of study. Logistic regression identified female gender (AOR = 2.15, p = 0.007), department, and higher level of study (AOR = 1.006, p = 0.001) as independent predictors. Conclusion Low hepatitis B vaccine uptake persists despite awareness; improving access, education, and mandatory policies is essential for high-risk health science students.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess HBV vaccination coverage and awareness among health science students in Nigeria, addressing the need to understand barriers to vaccination despite the availability of a safe and effective vaccine.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 410 health science students at Usmanu Danfodiyo University in Sokoto, Nigeria, from July 19 to September 10, 2025.
analysis.methods: Data were collected using a structured questionnaire and analyzed using IBM SPSS version 25, including descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, and binary logistic regression.
analysis.main_results: A total of 410 students participated, with high awareness (87.8%) but low uptake (26.8%) and only 12.2% fully vaccinated. Factors like vaccine inaccessibility, cost, and limited information were key barriers, while motivators included prior exposure to infection, institutional requirements, and trust in public health institutions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlighted the persistence of low HBV vaccine uptake despite awareness, suggesting the need for improved access, education, and mandatory policies for high-risk health science students.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform strategies to enhance HBV vaccination coverage and improve public health policies for health science students, reducing the risk of HBV infection and associated complications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit the generalizability of the findings. The sample size and specific demographic factors may also affect the representativeness of the results.

Key barriers included vaccine inaccessibility and cost, while motivators were prior infection exposure and institutional requirements. title_zh: 尼日利亚大学健康科学专业学生乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 覆盖率和职业风险暴露的横断面研究
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Despite the presence of a safe and effective vaccine for hepatitis B virus (HBV), health science students remain at significant risk for infection. This study assessed HBV vaccination coverage, awareness, and associated factors among health science students at Usmanu Danfodiyo University in Sokoto, Nigeria. Methodology A cross-sectional study targeting 427 health science students was conducted at Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto between July 19 and September 10, 2025. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire assessing hepatitis B awareness, vaccination status, barriers, motivators, and occupational risks. Analysis used IBM SPSS version 25, with descriptive statistics, chi-square tests ( p < 0.05), and binary logistic regression, while the Hosmer–Lemeshow test and Nagelkerke R2 assessed model fit and explained variance. Results A total of 410 students participated (mean age 22.36 ± 2.94 years). Awareness of the hepatitis B vaccine was high (87.8%), but uptake was low (26.8%), only 12.2% were fully vaccinated, and 50.7% of unvaccinated students were willing to vaccinate. Key barriers included vaccine inaccessibility, cost, and limited information, while major motivators were prior exposure to infection (57.3%), institutional requirements (47.6%), and trust in public health institutions (43.9%). Occupational exposures were common, with poor post-exposure practices. Uptake was significantly associated with department and level of study. Logistic regression identified female gender (AOR = 2.15, p = 0.007), department, and higher level of study (AOR = 1.006, p = 0.001) as independent predictors. Conclusion Low hepatitis B vaccine uptake persists despite awareness; improving access, education, and mandatory policies is essential for high-risk health science students.
abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 尽管存在针对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 的安全有效的 疫苗,但健康科学专业的学生仍然面临巨大的感染风险。本研究评估了尼日利亚索科托乌斯马努·丹佛迪约大学健康科学专业学生的 HBV 疫苗接种 覆盖率、认知度和相关因素。方法论 2025 年 7 月 19 日至 9 月 10 日,索科托乌斯马努·丹佛迪约大学 (Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto) 开展了一项针对 427 名健康科学专业学生的横断面研究。使用结构化问卷收集数据,评估乙型肝炎意识、疫苗接种 状态、障碍、激励因素和职业风险。分析使用 IBM SPSS 25 版,具有描述性统计、卡方检验 (p < 0.05) 和二元逻辑回归,而 Hosmer–Lemeshow 检验和 Nagelkerke R2 评估模型拟合度和解释方差。结果 共有 410 名学生参与(平均年龄 22.36 ± 2.94 岁)。对乙型肝炎疫苗的认知度较高(87.8%),但接种率较低(26.8%),只有12.2%的人完全接种了疫苗,未接种的学生中有50.7%愿意接种。主要障碍包括 疫苗 难以获取、成本和信息有限,而主要动机是先前接触过感染(57.3%)、机构要求(47.6%)和对公共卫生机构的信任(43.9%)。职业接触很常见,但接触后的做法很差。吸收与学习部门和水平显着相关。Logistic 回归将女性性别(AOR = 2.15,p = 0.007)、院系和更高的学习水平(AOR = 1.006,p = 0.001)确定为独立预测因素。结论 尽管知晓,但乙型肝炎 疫苗 的摄取率仍然较低;改善入学机会、教育和强制性政策对于高风险健康科学学生至关重要。

title: The impact of pretreatment HBs-Ag levels on response to interferon therapy in chronic hepatitis D patients.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection is closely associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Given the virological dependence of HDV on HBV for its replication, quantitative HBsAg levels have been considered as potential predictors of treatment outcomes. This study aims to investigate the actual role of pretreatment HBsAg levels as predictors of treatment response to Peg-IFNα therapy in chronic hepatitis D patients. METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 42 patients with chronic hepatitis D who had received a 48-week course of Peg-IFNα therapy (180 μg weekly). All of these patients were positive for HBsAg, anti-HDV, and HDV-RNA. Sustained virological response (SVR) was defined as undetectable HDV-RNA (<100 copies/mL) at 24 weeks subsequent to treatment completion (week 72). End-of-treatment (EOT) response was defined as undetectable HDV-RNA at week 48. Baseline quantitative HBsAg levels were measured using the Architect HBsAg assay. Statistical analyses included t-tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, Chi-square tests, and ROC analysis. RESULTS: Out of the 42 patients, 25 (59.5%) had available SVR data at week 72. Fourteen of them (56.0%) achieved SVR and 11 (44.0%) were non-responders. The mean baseline HBsAg level was 2972 IU/mL (±1208.8 SD). The t-test showed no significant difference in mean HBsAg levels between SVR responders (2789.4 IU/mL ±1421.8 SD) and non-responders (3185.2 IU/mL ±801.5 SD; p = 0.412). ROC analysis for SVR yielded an AUC of 0.589 (95% CI: 0.381-0.797). For EOT response, the AUC was 0.606 (95% CI: 0.421-0.791). Even though exploratory quartile analysis for EOT response revealed a significant association (p = 0.008), given the multiplicity of comparisons, this finding should be interpreted with caution. CONCLUSION: Baseline HBsAg levels do not predict SVR at 24 weeks post-treatment. The predictive value for EOT response is limited (AUC 0.606). Quantitative HBsAg testing alone is unlikely to provide sufficient predictive accuracy for clinical decision-making in CHD. Sustained HBsAg decline during treatment may provide a perusasive rationale for personalized treatment duration.

title_zh: 治疗前 HBs-Ag 水平对慢性丁型肝炎患者干扰素治疗反应的影响。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection is closely associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Given the virological dependence of HDV on HBV for its replication, quantitative HBsAg levels have been considered as potential predictors of treatment outcomes. This study aims to investigate the actual role of pretreatment HBsAg levels as predictors of treatment response to Peg-IFNα therapy in chronic hepatitis D patients. METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 42 patients with chronic hepatitis D who had received a 48-week course of Peg-IFNα therapy (180 μg weekly). All of these patients were positive for HBsAg, anti-HDV, and HDV-RNA. Sustained virological response (SVR) was defined as undetectable HDV-RNA (<100 copies/mL) at 24 weeks subsequent to treatment completion (week 72). End-of-treatment (EOT) response was defined as undetectable HDV-RNA at week 48. Baseline quantitative HBsAg levels were measured using the Architect HBsAg assay. Statistical analyses included t-tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, Chi-square tests, and ROC analysis. RESULTS: Out of the 42 patients, 25 (59.5%) had available SVR data at week 72. Fourteen of them (56.0%) achieved SVR and 11 (44.0%) were non-responders. The mean baseline HBsAg level was 2972 IU/mL (±1208.8 SD). The t-test showed no significant difference in mean HBsAg levels between SVR responders (2789.4 IU/mL ±1421.8 SD) and non-responders (3185.2 IU/mL ±801.5 SD; p = 0.412). ROC analysis for SVR yielded an AUC of 0.589 (95% CI: 0.381-0.797). For EOT response, the AUC was 0.606 (95% CI: 0.421-0.791). Even though exploratory quartile analysis for EOT response revealed a significant association (p = 0.008), given the multiplicity of comparisons, this finding should be interpreted with caution. CONCLUSION: Baseline HBsAg levels do not predict SVR at 24 weeks post-treatment. The predictive value for EOT response is limited (AUC 0.606). Quantitative HBsAg testing alone is unlikely to provide sufficient predictive accuracy for clinical decision-making in CHD. Sustained HBsAg decline during treatment may provide a perusasive rationale for personalized treatment duration.

title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

title_zh: 华支睾吸虫共感染增强 慢性乙型肝炎 患者多形核骨髓源性抑制细胞的扩增和代谢重编程
source_body_en: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.
abstract_zh: 背景已知华支睾吸虫(C. sinensis)合并感染会加速乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在两种感染流行的地区。代谢重编程已成为免疫抑制的关键驱动因素。这些代谢变化通常是由骨髓源性抑制细胞(MDSC)精心策划的,这些细胞在慢性感染期间会扩张以促进免疫耐受。中华丝虫合并感染会重新编程代谢以有利于 MDSC 相关的抑制,而这一过程与正常肝酶水平的关系仍不清楚。目的 探讨中华支原体合并感染是否会诱导肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者发生 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。方法 在这项横断面研究中,总共招募了 117 名参与者,并分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、单一感染中华支原体的参与者(n = 29)、单一感染 HBV 的参与者(n = 28)和混合感染的参与者(n = 30)。使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。进行 Spearman 相关性和中介分析来探讨炎症、代谢和免疫之间的关系。结果 HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,与HBV单一感染组相比,合并感染组的炎症细胞因子白细胞介素6(IL-6)和肿瘤坏死因子-α(TNF-α)水平较高,同时干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)水平明显较低。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。在代谢方面,共同感染组的鸟氨酸与精氨酸的比率显着较高。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。中华线虫合并感染通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高与免疫抑制相关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。

title: Renal vein thrombosis with hydronephrosis in seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with hepatitis B reactivity: a diagnostic challenge suggestive of renal tuberculosis
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is associated with an increased susceptibility to infection, while immunosuppressive treatment may further complicate the recognition and management of tuberculosis (TB). Renal TB is an indolent form of genitourinary TB that may present with non-specific constitutional and urinary manifestations and can cause obstructive uropathy. Renal vein thrombosis (RVT) is an uncommon vascular complication that may occur in the setting of systemic inflammation or infection. We report a 65-year-old man with recently diagnosed seropositive RA and hepatitis B surface antigen positivity who presented with six months of intermittent low-grade fever, constitutional symptoms and symmetrical inflammatory polyarthritis, followed by left flank pain, intermittent haematuria and bilateral lower-limb swelling. Laboratory evaluation showed anaemia, markedly elevated inflammatory markers and strongly positive rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP antibodies. HBsAg was positive, while HBV DNA was undetectable. Contrast-enhanced CT demonstrated a bulky left kidney with moderate hydronephrosis, pelvicalyceal dilatation, PUJ obstruction and left RVT with extensive collateral formation. Urine culture was sterile and renal function was preserved. Subsequent urine CBNAAT detected Mycobacterium tuberculosis and showed rifampicin susceptibility, establishing renal TB in the appropriate clinical and radiological context. The patient was treated with anticoagulation, RA-directed therapy, supportive measures and subsequently drug-susceptible antitubercular therapy. This case emphasizes the diagnostic challenge posed by overlapping inflammatory, infective and thrombotic manifestations and highlights the importance of considering renal TB in patients with hydronephrosis, urinary symptoms and unexplained RVT, particularly when routine bacterial cultures are sterile.
journal: International Journal of Research in Medical Sciences

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在强调在血清阳性类风湿性关节炎和乙型肝炎反应性患者中识别肾结核的诊断挑战,强调炎症、感染和血栓表现的重叠。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 病例报告 描述了一名 65 岁男性,最近被诊断为血清阳性 RA 和乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性,出现一系列症状,包括间歇性低热、全身症状、对称性炎性多关节炎、左侧腰部疼痛、间歇性血尿和双侧下肢肿胀。
elements_zh.methods: 患者接受了实验室评估,包括血液检查和尿培养,以及对比增强 CT 成像以评估肾静脉血栓形成和肾积水。尿液CBNAAT用于检测结核分枝杆菌并评估药敏。
elements_zh.main_results: 实验室评估显示贫血、炎症标志物显着升高、类风湿因子和抗 CCP 抗体强阳性。尿液 CBNAAT 检测到结核分枝杆菌并显示利福平敏感性,在适当的临床和放射学背景下证实肾结核。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为一个病例,强调了重叠的炎症、感染和血栓表现所带来的诊断挑战,并强调了在肾积水、泌尿系统症状和不明原因 RVT 患者中考虑肾结核的重要性,特别是当常规细菌培养无菌时。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于血清阳性类风湿性关节炎和乙型肝炎反应性患者,即使细菌培养物是无菌的,且出现不明原因的肾静脉血栓形成和肾积水,临床医生也应考虑肾结核。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是单一的病例报告,这限制了其普遍性。然而,考虑到临床和放射学背景,以及通过尿液 CBNAAT 确认结核分枝杆菌,证据是强有力的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在强调在血清阳性类风湿性关节炎和乙型肝炎反应性患者中识别肾结核的诊断挑战,强调炎症、感染和血栓表现的重叠。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 病例报告 描述了一名 65 岁男性,最近被诊断为血清阳性 RA 和乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性,出现一系列症状,包括间歇性低热、全身症状、对称性炎性多关节炎、左侧腰部疼痛、间歇性血尿和双侧下肢肿胀。
analysis_zh.methods: 患者接受了实验室评估,包括血液检查和尿培养,以及对比增强 CT 成像以评估肾静脉血栓形成和肾积水。尿液CBNAAT用于检测结核分枝杆菌并评估药敏。
analysis_zh.main_results: 实验室评估显示贫血、炎症标志物显着升高、类风湿因子和抗 CCP 抗体强阳性。尿液 CBNAAT 检测到结核分枝杆菌并显示利福平敏感性,在适当的临床和放射学背景下证实肾结核。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为一个病例,强调了重叠的炎症、感染和血栓表现所带来的诊断挑战,并强调了在肾积水、泌尿系统症状和不明原因 RVT 患者中考虑肾结核的重要性,特别是当常规细菌培养无菌时。

title: Factors Associated with Vaccination Completeness and Knowledge About Hepatitis B Among Undergraduate Nursing Students in Northeastern Brazil: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Hepatitis B remains an important occupational risk for undergraduate nursing students, particularly due to potential exposure, making vaccination and infection knowledge essential for protection throughout their professional careers. Objective: This study aimed to analyze the factors associated with vaccination completeness and knowledge about hepatitis B among undergraduate nursing students in Northeastern Brazil. Methods: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted with undergraduate nursing students from three campuses of a public university in Northeastern Brazil. Data were collected between October and December 2025 using validated instruments that assessed sociodemographic and academic characteristics, knowledge, and vaccination status through analysis of vaccination cards. Associations were assessed using multivariable binomial logistic regression, and results are shown as adjusted odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals. Results: Vaccination completeness (minimum of 3 doses of HepB vaccine) was observed in 74.3% of the undergraduate nursing students, while 57.9% demonstrated adequate knowledge about hepatitis B (minimum of 75% of assessment questions properly answered). The variables associated with lower odds of vaccination completeness were a family income lower than two minimum wages, not having taken the infectious diseases course, absence of training on hepatitis B, not having undergone rapid test for sexually transmitted diseases, and reported current use of illicit drugs. Regarding inadequate knowledge about hepatitis B, students who had not taken the course related to infectious diseases and those who had not undergone rapid tests for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B were more likely to have inadequate knowledge. In contrast, hepatitis B training and previous rapid testing were associated with lower likelihood of inadequate knowledge. Conclusions: A substantial proportion of nursing students was incompletely vaccinated, while most demonstrated a good level of knowledge about hepatitis B. The findings reinforce the need to strengthen immunization initiatives from the beginning of undergraduate education, particularly by improving access to vaccination and providing training on hepatitis B.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the association between educational and health-related factors and vaccination status and knowledge about hepatitis B among nursing students.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed factors associated with vaccination completeness and knowledge about hepatitis B among undergraduate nursing students in Northeastern Brazil. The study found that 74.3% of students were fully vaccinated, while 57.9% had adequate knowledge. Lower vaccination rates were linked to lower family income, lack of infectious diseases coursework, absence of hepatitis B training, and illicit drug use. Inadequate knowledge was associated with not taking infectious diseases courses and not undergoing rapid tests for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B. The study highlights the need for improved hepatitis B education and vaccination programs in nursing curricula. However, the cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎仍然是本科护生的一个重要职业风险,特别是由于潜在的接触,因此 疫苗接种 和感染知识对于他们整个职业生涯的保护至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对巴西东北部一所公立大学三个校区的护理本科生进行了一项分析性横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 数据是在 2025 年 10 月至 12 月期间使用经过验证的工具收集的,这些工具通过分析 疫苗接种 卡来评估社会人口统计和学术特征、知识以及 疫苗接种 状态。使用多变量二项式逻辑回归评估关联性,结果显示为调整后的比值比和 95% 置信区间。
elements_zh.main_results: 74.3% 的护理本科学生观察到 疫苗接种 完整性(至少 3 剂 HepB 疫苗),而 57.9% 的学生表现出对乙型肝炎有足够的了解(至少 75% 的评估问题正确回答)。与 疫苗接种 完整性较低几率相关的变量包括家庭收入低于最低工资两倍、未参加传染病课程、缺乏乙型肝炎培训、未接受性传播疾病快速检测以及报告目前使用非法药物。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了护生中教育和健康相关因素与 疫苗接种 乙型肝炎状况和知识之间的关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了将乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 和教育纳入本科护理课程以改善职业安全和公共卫生结果的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系,并且依赖自我报告的数据,可能会引入偏差。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎仍然是本科护生的一个重要职业风险,特别是由于潜在的接触,因此 疫苗接种 和感染知识对于他们整个职业生涯的保护至关重要。目的:本研究旨在分析巴西东北部本科护生乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 完整性和知识的相关因素。方法:对巴西东北部一所公立大学三个校区的护理本科生进行了一项横断面分析研究。数据是在 2025 年 10 月至 12 月期间使用经过验证的工具收集的,这些工具通过分析 疫苗接种 卡来评估社会人口统计和学术特征、知识以及 疫苗接种 状态。使用多变量二项式逻辑回归评估关联性,结果显示为调整后的比值比和 95% 置信区间。结果:74.3% 的本科护理生观察到 疫苗接种 完整性(至少 3 剂 HepB 疫苗),而 57.9% 的学生表现出足够的乙型肝炎知识(至少 75% 的评估问题正确回答)。与 疫苗接种 完整性较低几率相关的变量包括家庭收入低于最低工资两倍、未参加传染病课程、缺乏乙型肝炎培训、未接受性传播疾病快速检测以及报告目前使用非法药物。在乙肝知识匮乏方面,没有参加过传染病相关课程以及没有进行过艾滋病、梅毒、乙肝快速检测的学生知识匮乏的可能性更大。相比之下,乙型肝炎培训和之前的快速检测与知识不足的可能性较低有关。结论:相当一部分护生未完全接种疫苗,而大多数护生对乙型肝炎有良好的了解。研究结果强调了从本科教育开始就加强免疫举措的必要性,特别是通过改善 疫苗接种 的获取和提供乙型肝炎培训。

title: Knowledge and attitudes towards hepatitis B and hepatitis C among people living with HIV in Blantyre, Malawi: a cross-sectional survey
abstract: Introduction The high burden of hepatitis B and C is compounded by the high prevalence of HIV in sub-Saharan Africa. HIV–viral hepatitis co-infection increases the risk of liver-related complications, yet knowledge, attitudes, and testing practices among people living with HIV (PLWHIV) remain poorly characterized. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and utilization of viral hepatitis testing services among PLWHIV in Blantyre, Malawi.Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 299 PLWHIV attending urban and peri-urban antiretroviral therapy clinics between January and February 2025. Participants were recruited through non-probability consecutive sampling and completed structured questionnaires assessing sociodemographic characteristics, testing practices, knowledge, and attitudes towards viral hepatitis. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and study outcomes, while chi-square and Fisher’s exact tests assessed associations between categorical variables.Results Most participants were female (74.3%), aged 35–49 years (46.5%), and married (66.6%). Overall, 63.5% of participants had never been tested for viral hepatitis, 65.6% demonstrated poor knowledge, and 85.6% expressed positive attitudes towards prevention. Knowledge was higher among participants identifying as sexual minorities (gay or lesbian) than among heterosexual participants (p = 0.039), while positive attitudes were more frequent among employed participants (p = 0.005).Discussion The findings demonstrate substantial knowledge gaps and low testing uptake despite generally positive attitudes towards viral hepatitis prevention. Integrating targeted hepatitis education and routine testing into HIV care may improve access to prevention and testing services. Further research should evaluate the effectiveness of integrated education and testing interventions among PLWHIV.

abstract_zh: 简介 撒哈拉以南非洲地区艾滋病毒 患病率 的高感染率加剧了乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的高负担。HIV-病毒性肝炎合并感染会增加肝脏相关并发症的风险,但 HIV 感染者 (PLWHIV) 的知识、态度和检测实践仍知之甚少。本研究评估了马拉维布兰太尔的感染者和艾滋病毒感染者对病毒性肝炎检测服务的知识、态度和利用情况。方法对 2025 年 1 月至 2 月期间在城市和城郊抗逆转录病毒治疗诊所就诊的 299 名感染者和艾滋病毒感染者进行了横断面调查。通过非概率连续抽样招募参与者,并完成结构化调查问卷,评估社会人口特征、检测实践、知识和对病毒性肝炎的态度。使用 SPSS 27 版对数据进行分析。描述性统计总结了参与者特征和研究结果,而卡方和 Fisher 精确检验评估了分类变量之间的关联。结果 大多数参与者为女性 (74.3%)、年龄 35-49 岁 (46.5%) 和已婚 (66.6%)。总体而言,63.5%的参与者从未接受过病毒性肝炎检测,65.6%的参与者表现出知识匮乏,85.6%的参与者表示对预防持积极态度。被认定为性少数群体(男同性恋或女同性恋)的参与者的知识水平高于异性恋参与者(p = 0.039),而就业参与者中积极态度的频率更高(p = 0.005)。讨论 研究结果表明,尽管人们对病毒性肝炎预防普遍持积极态度,但仍存在巨大的知识差距和检测率较低。将有针对性的肝炎教育和常规检测纳入艾滋病毒护理可能会改善获得预防和检测服务的机会。进一步的研究应评估艾滋病毒携带者综合教育和检测干预措施的有效性。

title: Add-on versus switch to peginterferon in nucleos(t)ide analogue-treated chronic hepatitis B
abstract: This project contains the analysis dataset and code that reproduce the network meta-analysis reported in: **Chu X, Wang Y, Dai L, Wang L, Liu G, Ji G. Add-on versus switch to peginterferon in nucleos(t)ide analogue-treated chronic hepatitis B: a network meta-analysis weighing efficacy against virologic rebound.** The study compares add-on and switch-to peginterferon strategies against continued nucleos(t)ide analogue monotherapy in patients with chronic hepatitis B, using a frequentist random-effects network meta-analysis of 14 randomised controlled trials (1,640 patients in the network). All data were extracted from published trial reports; no individual patient data are included. ## Contents - `nma_data.csv` — per-arm extracted outcome data for the 14 included trials - `nma_analysis.R` — main network meta-analysis of HBsAg clearance (league table, network plot, forest plots, P-scores, node-splitting, net heat plot, sensitivity analysis excluding He 2016) - `funnel_v10.R` — comparison-adjusted funnel plot (Fig. S4) - `review_r1r2.R` — study-level meta-regressions (treatment duration, baseline HBsAg, NA duration, PEG-IFN type, HBeAg-positive proportion) and last-follow-up sensitivity analyses (ARES long-term follow-up; Al Ashgar 2017) - `ga_graphical_abstract.py` — graphical abstract figure (Python/matplotlib) - `README.txt` — variable definitions and running instructions

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the comparison of add-on versus switch to peginterferon strategies in patients with chronic hepatitis B who are already receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue treatment. The central question is whether these strategies differ in efficacy and virologic rebound when compared to continued nucleos(t)ide analogue monotherapy.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review employs a frequentist random-effects network meta-analysis of 14 randomised controlled trials involving 1,640 patients. All data were extracted from published trial reports, and no individual patient data are included. The analysis includes a league table, network plot, forest plots, P-scores, node-splitting, net heat plot, and sensitivity analysis excluding He 2016.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The network meta-analysis compares add-on and switch-to peginterferon strategies against continued nucleos(t)ide analogue monotherapy in patients with chronic hepatitis B. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges the limitations of the analysis, including the exclusion of certain studies and the potential for heterogeneity. The methods used may not fully address all aspects of the topic, and there are unresolved issues regarding the long-term follow-up and the impact of various factors on treatment outcomes.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest the need for further research on the long-term effects of add-on and switch-to peginterferon strategies, particularly in relation to virologic rebound and treatment duration. Additionally, there is a need for more detailed studies on the impact of baseline HBsAg levels, NA duration, PEG-IFN type, and HBeAg-positive proportion on treatment outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the efficacy and virologic rebound of add-on versus switch-to peginterferon strategies in patients with chronic hepatitis B receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue treatment. A network meta-analysis of 14 randomised controlled trials involving 1,640 patients was conducted using a frequentist random-effects model. The analysis includes various visualisations and sensitivity analyses to assess treatment outcomes. The study highlights the importance of considering factors such as baseline HBsAg levels, NA duration, and PEG-IFN type in treatment decisions. However, the review notes limitations, including the exclusion of certain studies and potential heterogeneity, suggesting the need for further research and more detailed investigations into the long-term effects of these strategies.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对涉及 1,640 名患者的 14 项随机对照试验采用了频率论随机效应网络荟萃分析。所有数据均从已发表的试验报告中提取,不包括个体患者数据。该分析包括排名表、网络图、森林图、P 分数、节点分裂、净热图和敏感性分析(不包括 He 2016)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该网络荟萃分析比较了 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的附加和转用聚乙二醇干扰素策略与持续核苷(酸)类似物单一疗法。该研究对疗效和病毒学反弹进行了综合评估,结果和结论来自对这些试验的分析。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述承认分析的局限性,包括排除某些研究和潜在的异质性。所使用的方法可能无法完全解决该主题的所有方面,并且在长期随访以及各种因素对 治疗 结果的影响方面存在未解决的问题。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,需要进一步研究添加和转用聚乙二醇干扰素策略的长期影响,特别是与病毒学反弹和 治疗 持续时间相关的影响。此外,需要对基线 HBsAg 水平、NA 持续时间、PEG-IFN 类型和 HBeAg 阳性比例对 治疗 结果的影响进行更详细的研究。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注已接受核苷(酸)类似物 治疗 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的附加策略与改用聚乙二醇干扰素策略的比较。核心问题是,与持续的核苷类似物单一疗法相比,这些策略在疗效和病毒学反弹方面是否存在差异。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对涉及 1,640 名患者的 14 项随机对照试验采用了频率论随机效应网络荟萃分析。所有数据均从已发表的试验报告中提取,不包括个体患者数据。该分析包括排名表、网络图、森林图、P 分数、节点分裂、净热图和敏感性分析(不包括 He 2016)。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该网络荟萃分析比较了 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的附加和转用聚乙二醇干扰素策略与持续核苷(酸)类似物单一疗法。该研究对疗效和病毒学反弹进行了综合评估,结果和结论来自对这些试验的分析。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述承认分析的局限性,包括排除某些研究和潜在的异质性。所使用的方法可能无法完全解决该主题的所有方面,并且在长期随访以及各种因素对 治疗 结果的影响方面存在未解决的问题。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,需要进一步研究添加和转用聚乙二醇干扰素策略的长期影响,特别是与病毒学反弹和 治疗 持续时间相关的影响。此外,需要对基线 HBsAg 水平、NA 持续时间、PEG-IFN 类型和 HBeAg 阳性比例对 治疗 结果的影响进行更详细的研究。

title: Snake kolmiovirus encodes a single form of delta antigen and shows no evidence of translation from ORF2
abstract: Hepatitis D virus (HDV) is a satellite virus that utilizes hepatitis B virus (HBV) as a helper for infectious particle formation. HDV was originally identified as a novel antigen in liver biopsies of HBV patients, and later studies showed the ‘delta’ antigen (DAg) to be the sole protein encoded by HDV. Until the discovery of HDV- like agents in birds and snakes in 2018, HDV was a unique example of animal satellite viruses. We identified Swiss snake colony virus 1 (SwSCV-1) in the brain of a Boa constrictor and through comparison we found the genome organization of SwSCV-1 to resemble that of HDV. However, in addition to the DAg ORF, the genome of SwSCV-1 includes another >500 nt ORF, ‘ORF2’. To study whether the putative ORF2-encoded protein plays a role in the SwSCV-1 life cycle, we established an infectious clone of the virus with a point mutation in the methionine initiation codon of ORF2. The mutation did not significantly affect initiation of replication, establishment of persistent infection or infectious particle formation upon superinfection with a helper virus. Using additional methods, we gathered further evidence confirming that ORF2 is not actively translated in boa constrictor cells. We further showed that unlike HDV, SwSCV-1 expresses a single form of the DAg. Although the proteins encoded by SwSCV-1 and HDV only include one and two forms of the DAg, respectively, whether other kolmioviruses express additional forms of DAg or related proteins in some cell types or host species merits further research.

title: Burden, healthcare utilization, and costs of chronic liver disease–related hospitalizations in California: a population-based study of trends and projections, 2005–2035
abstract: Background Long-term trends in hospitalization burden, healthcare utilization, and costs of chronic liver disease (CLD) in the United States remain poorly characterized. Using statewide hospital discharge data, we quantified trends from 2005 to 2018 and projected future burden through 2035 across demographic subgroups. Methods We used average annual percent change (AAPC) to quantify trends in hospitalized patients, hospitalizations, deaths, along with age-standardized rates (ASHPR, ASHR, and ASMR); hospitalizations per patient-year, average length of stay, 30-day readmission, in-hospital mortality; and inflation-adjusted hospital charges (2019 US dollars). Analyses were conducted overall and for hepatitis B virus(HBV), hepatitis C virus(HCV), alcohol-associated liver disease(ALD), and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Findings From 2005 to 2018, hospitalized CLD patients increased from 71,214 to 122,810 (AAPC, 4.37%; 95% CI, 3.87%–4.88%), and deaths from 11,455 to 24,560 (6.02%; 4.20%–7.86%). ASHPR increased from 275.12 to 377.88 per 100,000, and ASMR from 45.53 to 74.77. Hospitalizations and charges increased from 116,482 to 185,268 and $9.63 billion to $18.63 billion, while in-hospital mortality declined (AAPC, −7.02%; 95% CI, −8.72%–5.30%). MASLD- and ALD-related hospitalizations increased, whereas HBV- and HCV-related hospitalizations declined. Men had higher hospitalization and mortality rates, particularly for ALD. Hispanic populations had the fastest-rising burden, driven by MASLD; HBV burden was concentrated among non-Hispanic Asian populations, whereas overall CLD and ALD-related mortality were highest among non-Hispanic White populations. Interpretation Findings highlight the need for targeted prevention and screening, early management of metabolic and alcohol-related risk factors, and equitable access to liver care.

title: DETECTION OF HEPATITIS B AND C VIRAL INFECTION AMONG CHILDREN WITH ACUTE LEUKAEMIA.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Viral hepatitis, particularly Hepatitis B (HBV) and Hepatitis C (HCV), represents a significant health complication in immunocompromised patients, including children diagnosed with acute leukaemia. These patients are at increased risk of getting infections due to frequent blood transfusions, invasive procedures, and immunosuppressive therapy. The study aimed to evaluate the occurrence of hepatitis B and C virus infection among children with acute leukaemia treated in the pediatric haematology unit at Ibn Al-Ather Teaching Hospital in Mosul city, compare them with a control group and evaluate associated risk factors, including vaccination status. METHODS: This study enrolled a total of 180 children attending Ibn-Al-Atheer Teaching Hospital (Mosul City, Iraq), comprising 90 patients diagnosed with Acute Leukemia and 90 age- and sex-matched controls. The control group included children attending the hospital for conditions unrelated to haematological diseases or predisposing factors for Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C, and had no history of chronic illness. Blood samples were collected and tested for HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HCV antibodies using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) kits. Demographic and clinical data, including vaccination history, were reported and statistically analysed. RESULTS: No significant variation was observed between cases and controls in sex, age, or residency (P>0.05). HBsAg positivity was higher in cases (26.7%) than controls (10.0%) (P=0.005). Anti-HCV was also higher in cases (10.0%) vs controls (2.2%) (P=0.035). HBV vaccination was protective (7.4% vs 34.9%, P=0.004). Blood transfusion was strongly associated with infection (60.0% vs 4.4%, P<0.001). CONCLUSION: HBV and HCV infections were significantly higher in leukemic children. Blood transfusion was a major risk factor, while HBV vaccination had a protective effect. Strengthening screening and vaccination is essential.

title: Combining Antiviral Therapy with Cancer Treatment in HBV-associated HCC: A Translational Approach.
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health concern and is a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Despite advances in antiviral therapy and cancer treatment, HBV-related HCC (HBV-HCC) continues to pose significant challenges due to its complex pathogenesis involving chronic inflammation, viral persistence, and liver fibrosis. Current antiviral therapies reduce viral load and liver inflammation but often fail to eliminate integrated viral DNA or prevent carcinogenesis. On the other hand, cancer therapies such as surgery, ablation, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy have limited success when used in isolation, especially in patients with active HBV replication. This review examines the emerging concept of combining antiviral and anticancer strategies to improve clinical outcomes in HBV-HCC. We discuss the molecular mechanisms linking HBV infection to HCC, the role of antiviral therapy in reducing recurrence post-HCC treatment, and the impact of HBV reactivation during cancer therapy. In addition, we explore emerging biomarkers for early detection and prognosis, the therapeutic implications of HBV DNA integration, and the potential of gene-editing technologies targeting viral reservoirs. We further review the influence of HBV-induced immune dysregulation on immunotherapy outcomes, the relevance of host-microbiome interactions in liver carcinogenesis, and the utility of precision medicine approaches in guiding treatment. We highlight recent translational studies, clinical trials, and future directions that support a dual-modality approach, aiming for long-term remission and improved survival in patients with HBV-HCC.

title: Towards broader-spectrum direct-acting antivirals against RNA viruses.
abstract: Small molecule antiviral drugs have transformed the management of infections such as those caused by HIV, hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, herpesviruses and influenza viruses. Effective antiviral therapeutics remain unavailable for many other often life-threatening viral infections, many of which are caused by RNA viruses. The development of potent, safe and orally available antivirals is therefore essential both to address current unmet medical needs and to strengthen epidemic and pandemic preparedness. In this Review, we discuss the rationale for building a diversified portfolio of broader-spectrum antivirals against RNA viruses with activity spanning multiple genera, entire families or even crossing viral families. We provide a non-exhaustive overview of approved and investigational antiviral agents active against RNA viruses and discuss the biological determinants that underlie their antiviral spectrum. Finally, we outline the clinical development frameworks required to accelerate the evaluation of such drugs, in particular in the context of outbreaks.

title: CDC AIDS Project 72: The Prostitute Study.
abstract: In the early years of the AIDS epidemic, the occurrence and potential for heterosexual transmission of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV 1) in the United States were uncertain. To better understand infection among women and the possible role of prostitution in the emerging epidemic, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention established CDC AIDS Project 72, a multisite study of 1 410 women with recent histories of prostitution recruited from eight areas of the United States during 1986 and 1987. Participants were interviewed, examined, and tested for serologic markers of HIV 1, hepatitis B virus (HBV), syphilis, herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2 (HSV 1 and HSV 2), and human T cell lymphotropic virus types I and II (HTLV I/II). HIV 1 antibodies were detected in approximately 12% of women tested, but prevalence varied considerably across study sites. HSV 2 was the most commonly detected infection, followed by HSV 1, HBV, syphilis, HIV 1, and HTLV I/II. HIV 1, HBV, and HTLV I/II were strongly associated with injection drug use, whereas syphilis and HSV 2 followed different patterns related to sexual exposure. Among women without evidence of injection drug use, infrequent condom use during vaginal intercourse with clients was associated with HIV 1 infection. Project 72 showed that prostitution alone did not explain infection risk among these women. Injection drug use, sexual and injection networks, local prevalence of infection, and the social circumstances in which women lived and worked were also important. The project contributed to an evolving public health approach that emphasized epidemiologic evidence, cooperation with affected communities, and practical strategies for reducing risk rather than assumptions about stigmatized populations.

title: Global, Regional and National Burden of Viral Hepatitis From 1990 to 2021 With Forecasts to 2046: Findings From the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021.
abstract: Viral hepatitis constitutes a primary cause of liver cirrhosis and carcinoma and ranks as the second leading cause of mortality worldwide due to challenges in early detection and limited preventive measures, thereby posing a significant threat to public health. This study analyses the burden and risk factors associated with viral hepatitis at global, regional, and national levels from 1990 to 2021, and projects the disease burden from 2022 to 2046. From 1990 to 2021, the global burden of viral hepatitis increased, despite a decline in age-standardized rates. Population growth emerged as the primary driver influencing this trend, with the highest disease burden observed in the African region. A high body-mass index (BMI) demonstrated a distinct and significant association with the sustained increase in disease burden. Excessive alcohol consumption was identified as the leading cause of hepatitis B, while drug abuse was predominantly linked to hepatitis C. Notably, males exhibited a markedly higher susceptibility to these risk factors compared to females. Over the next 25 years, the disease burden of hepatitis A, B, C and E is projected to remain stable or decline. Viral hepatitis remains a significant global public health challenge. It is imperative to strengthen efforts to prevent alcohol and drug abuse, consistently advance disease detection and treatment methods, and enable low- and middle-income countries to improve healthcare infrastructure and expand vaccination coverage. These measures are essential to promptly reduce the disease burden and achieve the goal of eliminating viral hepatitis by 2030.

title: Nativity as a Clinical Variable in Gastric Cancer Prevention: An Immigrant Health Perspective.
abstract: Marked differences in gastric cancer risk among immigrant populations have long been recognized, yet migration-related information remains underutilized in routine clinical care. Nativity is more than a demographic characteristic; it serves as a pragmatic surrogate for cumulative life-course exposures, including early-life environmental conditions, Helicobacter pylori acquisition, dietary patterns, and socioeconomic influences that shape gastric cancer risk long after migration. Although birthplace and exposure history are routinely incorporated into prevention strategies for conditions such as hepatitis B virus infection and latent tuberculosis, comparable approaches remain underdeveloped in gastric cancer prevention. This narrative review examines the epidemiologic, biologic, and clinical evidence supporting nativity as an important component of gastric cancer risk assessment in immigrant populations. We review evidence that gastric cancer risk declines after migration from high-incidence to low-incidence countries but does not fully converge with host-population levels, suggesting persistent effects of early-life exposures. We further discuss how declining H. pylori prevalence and increasing eradication rates may weaken the ability of current infection status alone to reflect cumulative carcinogenic exposure and lifetime risk. We argue that the principal challenge is increasingly one of implementation. Despite growing recognition of migration-related disparities, healthcare systems rarely capture or use nativity in ways that inform gastric cancer prevention. Incorporating nativity and migration history into electronic health records, clinical decision-support tools, and risk-stratification frameworks may help to identify high-risk individuals and support more equitable, risk-based prevention strategies. More broadly, this framework illustrates how life-course exposure history can be translated into actionable clinical care for increasingly diverse populations.

title: Successful Reversal of Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure and Cirrhosis by Combined Chinese-Western Medicine: A 5-Year Follow-up and a Cautionary Tale of Fatal Relapse After Antiviral Withdrawal
abstract: Abstract Background Acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF) in patients with chronic hepatitis B and cirrhosis carries an extremely high short-term mortality rate. We report a case of successful reversal of end-stage liver failure and cirrhosis by combined Chinese-Western medicine, followed by a fatal relapse after self-discontinuation of antiviral therapy. Case Presentation A 36-year-old male with a 9-year history of hepatitis B was admitted to a tertiary liver disease hospital in Beijing on November 10, 2007, with decompensated cirrhosis, massive ascites, and infection. Despite medical management, his condition deteriorated, with laboratory tests on December 17, 2007, showing a prothrombin activity (PTA) of 28.7%, an INR of 2.585, and a total bilirubin of 136.5 μmol/L, indicating irreversible end-stage liver failure with classic bile-enzyme separation. The family was informed that no curative treatment was available, and the patient was discharged against medical advice on December 19, 2007. Combined Chinese-Western medicine treatment was initiated at our institute on the same day. After 8 days of treatment, PTA rapidly increased to 46.3%, and INR decreased to 1.77. Liver function and coagulation profiles gradually normalized over the following months. By 2012, all laboratory parameters, including PTA (100%) and INR (1.01), had returned to normal, with resolution of splenomegaly and imaging evidence of cirrhosis reversal. The patient remained clinically stable for 5 years. In late 2012, the patient self-discontinued lamivudine for 3 months, leading to ACLF relapse. Due to delays in receiving standardized emergency care at two consecutive hospitals without artificial liver support technology, the patient ultimately died. Conclusion This case demonstrates the remarkable potential of combined Chinese-Western medicine in reversing end-stage liver failure and cirrhosis. It also serves as a critical warning: antiviral therapy must not be self-discontinued, and ACLF relapse requires immediate access to standardized emergency care with artificial liver support.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF) in patients with chronic hepatitis B and cirrhosis carries an extremely high short-term mortality rate. We report a case of successful reversal of end-stage liver failure and cirrhosis by combined Chinese-Western medicine, followed by a fatal relapse after self-discontinuation of antiviral therapy. Case Presentation A 36-year-old male with a 9-year history of hepatitis B was admitted to a tertiary liver disease hospital in Beijing on November 10, 2007, with decompensated cirrhosis, massive ascites, and infection. Despite medical management, his condition deteriorated, with laboratory tests on December 17, 2007, showing a prothrombin activity (PTA) of 28.7%, an INR of 2.585, and a total bilirubin of 136.5 μmol/L, indicating irreversible end-stage liver failure with classic bile-enzyme separation. The family was informed that no curative treatment was available, and the patient was discharged against medical advice on December 19, 2007. Combined Chinese-Western medicine treatment was initiated at our institute on the same day. After 8 days of treatment, PTA rapidly increased to 46.3%, and INR decreased to 1.77. Liver function and coagulation profiles gradually normalized over the following months. By 2012, all laboratory parameters, including PTA (100%) and INR (1.01), had returned to normal, with resolution of splenomegaly and imaging evidence of cirrhosis reversal. The patient remained clinically stable for 5 years. In late 2012, the patient self-discontinued lamivudine for 3 months, leading to ACLF relapse. Due to delays in receiving standardized emergency care at two consecutive hospitals without artificial liver support technology, the patient ultimately died. Conclusion This case demonstrates the remarkable potential of combined Chinese-Western medicine in reversing end-stage liver failure and cirrhosis. It also serves as a critical warning: antiviral therapy must not be self-discontinued, and ACLF relapse requires immediate access to standardized emergency care with artificial liver support.

title: Profound Depletion of CPB2 and MASP2 Predicts Hepatic Synthetic Collapse and Transplant Indications in HBV-Related Acute Liver Failure
abstract: Abstract Purpose Hepatitis B virus-related acute liver failure (HBV-ALF) is a highly lethal syndrome lacking precise early biomarkers to guide the timing of liver transplantation (LT). Aims We aimed to identify core drivers of hepatic synthetic collapse and explore novel prognostic biomarkers and targeted therapeutic strategies for HBV-ALF. Methods An integrated machine learning framework (LASSO, SVM-RFE) was applied to multi-cohort transcriptomic datasets to identify crucial diagnostic hub genes. Findings were rigorously validated in a real-world clinical cohort of HBV-ALF patients using serum biochemistry and spatial histopathology (H&E and IHC staining). Results We identified a profound disruption of the complement-coagulation crosstalk as a hallmark of HBV-ALF. Three critical hub genes—C8B, CPB2, and MASP2—were significantly downregulated. In clinical validation, CPB2 levels plummeted to approximately 26% of the normal baseline, strongly correlating with declining prothrombin time activity (PTA) and surging MELD scores. Spatial histopathology revealed a paradoxical microenvironment: massive necrosis with a near-complete loss of these locally synthesized proteins, accompanied by intense overactivation of the terminal complement complex (C5b-9) strictly bordering the surviving parenchyma. Conclusions The precipitous depletion of C8B, CPB2, and MASP2 serves as a highly sensitive real-time biomarker for irreversible hepatic synthetic exhaustion, offering a novel metric to refine LT indications. Furthermore, targeting the localized C5b-9 overactivation presents a promising therapeutic strategy to halt the necrotic cascade and serve as a "bridge to transplant" in HBV-ALF.

title: Exploratory analysis of transcriptionally active HBV-host chimeric transcript burden in patients with increasing HBsAg during long-term antiviral therapy
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: The longitudinal relationship between transcriptionally active hepatitis B virus (HBV) integration dynamics and serum hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) during long-term antiviral therapy remains unclear. METHODS: Patients with HBV-related fibrosis/cirrhosis who underwent at least one liver biopsy at baseline, week 78, or week 260 were enrolled. HBsAg increase was defined as either a ≥5% increase from baseline to week 208 or at least two ≥5% increases between consecutive available visits. A subset of 10 patients with serial liver RNA sequencing underwent integrated clinical, transcriptomic, and histopathological analyses. HBV-host chimeric transcripts were identified using ChimericSeq and verified by BLAST, and intrahepatic HBsAg was assessed by immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: Overall, 31.8% (99/311) of patients met the criteria for HBsAg increase, while others were classified into the stable/decrease group. Lower baseline HBsAg and higher histologic activity index (HAI) were independently associated with HBsAg increase (both p < 0.05). In the serial-biopsy subset (n = 10), patients in the HBsAg increase group (4/4) showed increased HBV-host chimeric transcript burden at week 260 versus week 78, whereas the six patients in the stable/decrease group showed stable or reduced burden. Intrahepatic HBsAg immunohistochemistry showed persistent clustered cytoplasmic positivity, with transcriptomic analysis indicating downregulation of multiple immune-related pathways in the HBsAg increase group. CONCLUSION: About 31.8% of patients had HBsAg increase during antiviral therapy. Baseline HBsAg and HAI were associated with HBsAg increase during antiviral therapy. In the exploratory serial-biopsy subset, patients with HBsAg increase tended to exhibit an increase in transcriptionally active HBV-host chimeric transcript burden and persistent clustered cytoplasmic HBsAg positivity.
